notes.title: To all Commanders: Development Update on The Book of Yog
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Starting this week, Hangzhou has slipped into late summer—sometimes a little cool breeze, and autumn is quietly sneaking in. About two months ago we shared our dev log with you, but since the upcoming content is huge, the game's development has recently slowed down. So here's a little progress update from us:[/p][p][/p][h2]1. Endgame PvE (Otherworld)[/h2][p]• New loot will be added gradually, including legendary gear, treasures, and upgrade stones.[/p][p]• Equipment will have more randomness. Special gear has unique attributes that cannot be modified. No paid content—everything depends on luck. Trading Hall support is planned.[/p][p]• PvE tests farming strategies, map and loot knowledge, and team planning for optimal Magic Find routes.[/p][p]•Not mindless grinding: maps have unique strategies, drops, rare bosses, and special modes.[/p][p]•Seasonal model will bring new maps, mechanics, and loot each season.[/p][p]•Release: aiming for late October, latest by late November.[/p][p][/p][h2]2. New Social & PvP [/h2][p]We're also working on a big tech upgrade to roll out a new open-world scene.[/p][p]Here, players in the same region will finally be connected live—you'll see each other moving around, interacting, and fighting for resources and cities, or just roaming the world for fun.[/p][p]It's basically going to be a massive seafaring world, where you can build your own fleet and sail out to conquer the seas. Development is moving fast, and we'll share more soon![/p][p][/p][h2]3. Combat Balance[/h2][p]We are working on combat balance. Given the complexity of online play and the need to protect players' interests, we are still in the research and calculation stage. Our goals are:[/p][p]• SP heroes should be relatively balanced, with no completely unusable characters.[/p][p]• Improve and unify game mechanics, reduce redundant designs, and create multiple viable playstyles with dynamic balance, rather than crude rock-paper-scissors or dominance by a single option.[/p][p]• Differences between hero tiers should be reasonable, aiming for a more balanced system that enhances the depth and seriousness of combat.[/p][p][/p][h2]4. Looking Forward[/h2][p]Running this game has taught us a lot, and your feedback has been huge. Our promise: better balance, smoother progression and collection, and more fun social systems.[/p][p]Thanks so much for playing Book of Yog. Your support keeps us going—see you in the next update![/p]

Guild Ascension now requires reaching Yggdrasil Level 1150 (expected to be reached in about 20 days under normal progression).[/p][p]2. Ascension skill caps will now scale with Yggdrasil Level. (If you wish to retain the original stat bonuses, please avoid resetting your Ascension skill levels lightly.)[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="227,131,"][tr][td colwidth="227"][p][b]Level Limit for Ascension Skills[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="131"][p][b]Yggdrasil Level[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Stage Prerequisites[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="227"][p]5[/p][/td][td colwidth="131"][p]1150[/p][/td][td][p]Clear Chapter 14 of Normal Exploration[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="227"][p]15[/p][/td][td colwidth="131"][p]1200[/p][/td][td][p]Mist Layers: 600[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="227"][p]25[/p][/td][td colwidth="131"][p]1250[/p][/td][td][p]Clear Oblivion Places 1[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="227"][p]35[/p][/td][td colwidth="131"][p]1300[/p][/td][td][p]Clear Oblivion Places 3[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="227"][p]45[/p][/td][td colwidth="131"][p]1350[/p][/td][td][p]Clear any Journey Story on Normal difficulty[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="227"][p]55[/p][/td][td colwidth="131"][p]1400[/p][/td][td][p]Clear any Journey Story on Hard difficulty[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="227"][p]65[/p][/td][td colwidth="131"][p]1450[/p][/td][td][p]Clear any Journey Story on Black Tide 1 difficulty[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="227"][p]100[/p][/td][td colwidth="131"][p]1500[/p][/td][td][p]Clear any Journey Story on Black Tide 1 difficulty[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]【BUG Fixes and Other Optimization】[/b][/h1][p]-Removed Awakening requirement for SS level cap.[/p][p]-Fixed an issue where the difficulty of the Oblivion Places was abnormally reduced.[/p][p]-\[Theiana Adjustments][/p][p]\[Holy Pursuit]: Added +25% damage against boss monsters；[/p][p]Sanguine 2 – \[Divine Blade]: During casting, now grants full immunity to Stun, Freeze, Charm, Polymorph, and Knock-up (previously only immune to control and knock-up);[/p][p]Sanguine 5: Now allows own skills to damage enemies in an Invincible state. Original effect “When \[Shorebound Refraction] triggers, applies Physical Armor Break to the enemy” has been merged into Blood Tier 4;[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes of July 30
notes.content: [p]Dear Commander:[/p][p]We plan to start update maintenance at 15:00, July 30 (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to take 120 - 240 minutes.[/p][p]*Please pay attention to the community and in-game rolling announcements for specific times.[/p][p][/p][p]After the maintenance, please update the client to the latest version before start the game.[/p][p][/p][p]During the maintenance, the players will be forcibly disconnected and unable to login. Please logout before the maintenance to avoid any data loss.[/p][p][/p][p]The following is the introduction of update contents:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[New Blackguard][/b][/h2][p][/p][p]<New SP Light Type Striker Blackguard> - Radiant Vigil, Theiana[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/1d3853192031e0d447280b2c8e9f0b4866551126.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/8890de06dc099a791937bcdbca8f1c213727bf01.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Banner Added:Light & Dark Arrival[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The summon rate for Light & Dark SP Blackguards is the same as in the Sanguine Summon.[/p][p][/p][p]-This banner has a separate pity counter, with a guaranteed summon at 120 pulls. Drop rate increases as pulls accumulate, and resets upon obtaining the featured Light & Dark SP Blackguards.[/p][p]-Light & Dark Blackguards can join all attribute stages in Paradox Sailing.[/p][p]-Physical growth from Guild Ascension also boosts Light attributes.[/p][p]-Light & Dark Blackguards have an exclusive Divinity talent system, upgradeable with Divinity Shards.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Damage Type: Holy[/b] [/p][p]-Holy Damage is affected by Physical Damage bonuses and is reduced by Physical Damage Reduction and Physical Armor.[/p][p]-Some effects that are triggered by Physical Damage will also be triggered by Holy Damage. (Details will be indicated on the relevant effects.)[/p][p]- Damage bonuses against specific attributes in Paradox Sailing,  Journey Story, and Everwinter Land will also apply to Holy Damage. (Only the highest applicable bonus will be used.)[/p][p]-When a Light Blackguard uses a Contract Skill that deals Physical Damage, it will be treated as Holy Damage.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[3rd Anniversary] Optional Banner[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]To celebrate the 3rd anniversary of The Book of Yog, a limited-time Optional Banner is now available![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Available Blackguards in this Banner:[/p][p]Coltish Artillerist、Legendary Dragon、Foxy Archduchess、Coffin Morrigan、Thorny Bramble、Centaur Minerva、Schneemond Princess、Shadowy Mirage、Nirvana Ignis、Judgement Hammer、 Lady Swan Lake、Shamneko in Night、Blooming Ink Deer、Marine Rime、Flabellum Seraph、Falling Samele、Tundra Thunder、Everlasting Sol、Flicker Pierce、Jadeform Immortal、Phantasmal Dream[/p][p][/p][p]Duration: After update ~ August 27th[/p][p][/p][p][i]All players can re-select their desired character from the banner.Pity progress from previous draws will be retained.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Once the selected SP Blackguard has been summoned, it can no longer be changed to another available SP Blackguard.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[Elemental Force—Frost][/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Limited-time Frost type SP exclusive banner now available！[/p][p]Duration: After Update ~ 2025.08.27 12:00[/p][p]SP included: Vina / Heliina / Chloe / Stephine / Kashinfuu / Darlita[/p][p]When hitting the jackpot, you will randomly obtain one of the SP Blackguards (with priority given to those who have not reached the maximum Sanguine Level).[/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[Limited-time Story Event][/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Event:【Divine Petition】(Duration: after update ~ August. 20, 2025)[/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to participate in limited-time story event \[Divine Petition]. By participating in the event, you can earn currency as rewards. The currency can be used to strengthen characters in the event, and the rewards can be exchanged in the Divine Petition shop for items like Commander's Swimsuit Golden Strands, Theiana weapon skin Solar Ascension, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[Mall Update][/b][/h2][p]Blacktide Shop–Added Reset Stones for Sale[/p][p]Blacktide Shop–Added Bound Gold for Sale[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[New Gears][/b][/h2][p]<New Casting Gears>[/p][p]Added the following exclusive casting gear for the Blackguards. The casting formula price is Blacktide Medal x50[/p][p]Ruo: Mournful Whisperblade[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[Academy Cup S23 Season][/b][/h2][p]Season duration: August 01, 2025 ~ August 29, 2025[/p][p]Participating in the Academy Cup competition, the top-ranked commanders will obtain the following rewards:[/p][p]Exclusive Avatar Frame: Glare: Dawnlight Rite, Glare: New Age, Glare: Everglow, Glare: Wishes[/p][p]Exclusive Title: Eternal Glow[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[Everwinter Land][/b][/h2][p]\[Everwinter Land] Season 53 and 54 is about to start. Due to the blessing of Lightning, Light type heroes will enjoy additional combat ability improvements in the battle of \[Everwinter Land].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[Events][/b][/h2][p][/p][p][i][b]<New Recurring Event: Sanguine Draw>[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]After each new Blackguard is released, commanders can purchase entries via the platform to join a server-wide lottery. Winners will be announced 3 days after the event starts and will receive the Sanguine reward of the featured Blackguard. All other participants will receive Sanguine Stone as a consolation prize.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]<New Recurring Event: PASS REWARDS>[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Duration: 2025.08.01 ~ 2025.09.30[/p][p][/p][p]During the event, commanders earn Pass points by spending FP or AP. Level up the Pass to claim rewards. Purchasing the Premium Pass unlocks extra rewards including Theiana's Wings Skin Scalding Blaze, Sanguine Optional Box, and Sanguine Stone.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]<Journey Story>[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Duration: After update ~ 2025.08.26[/p][p]Clear Journey Story stages during the event to receive double drop rewards (up to 100 times).[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]<Fitch's Stitched Pumpkin (Re)>[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Duration: After update ~ 2025.08.13[/p][p][/p][p]During the event, spending FP grants a chance to obtain the event item: \[Fitch's Stitched Pumpkin], which contains various Stones, AP, and other rewards.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]<Limited-time Spending Rewards>[/b][/i][/p][p]Duration: After Update ~ 2025.08.27 12:00[/p][p]Complete event spending requirements to obtain the following skins and more rewards:[/p][p]100,000 Points: Kashinfuu's Skin < Ice Slumber >[/p][p]1,000,000 Points: Supreme Skin Chest (Pick one of the skin from some of the past Limited-time Spending Rewards)[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]<New 14 Days Sign-in>[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]【Prismatic Starlight】[/p][p]Qualification Activation：2025-08-01~2025-08-14，the sign-in event will end on August 27th, 2025[/p][p][/p][p]Day1：Blacktide Medal *100[/p][p]Day2：Sanguine Stone *300[/p][p]Day3：Blacktide Medal *100[/p][p]Day4：Sanguine Stone *300[/p][p]Day5：Blacktide Medal *100[/p][p]Day6：Sanguine Stone *300[/p][p]Day7：Dark Abyss Contract *30[/p][p]Day8：Sanguine Stone *150[/p][p]Day9:  Sanguine Stone *150[/p][p]Day10: Sanguine Stone *150[/p][p]Day11: Sanguine Stone *150[/p][p]Day12: Blackguard Casting Chest*1[/p][p]Day13: Sanguine Stone *300[/p][p]Day14: Commander’s weapon skin: Tidebreaker[/p][p][/p][p][b]<Lottery Event – [i]Isabena’[/i]s Weapon Skin>[/b][/p][p]Duration: After Update ~ 2025.08.27 12:00[/p][p]Introduction: By consuming <Lucky Charm> in the Lottery Event, you have a chance to obtain Isabena ‘s weapon skin < Delirious Voice > and other rich prize.[/p][p][/p][p][b]<Lottery Re-run - Chesia's Weapon Skin>[/b][/p][p]Duration: After Update ~ 2025.08.27 12:00[/p][p]Introduction: By consuming <Emblem of Luck Essence> in the Lottery Re-run, you have a chance to obtain Chesia 's weapon skin < Featherfall Finale > and other rich prize.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]<Lottery Re-run - Additional Pool for Ojeda’s Weapon Skin!>[/b][/i][/p][p]Duration: After Update ~ 2025.08.27 12:00[/p][p]Introduction: By consuming <Emblem of Luck Essence> in the Lottery Re-run, you have a chance to obtain the following skins and other rich prize:[/p][p]Ojeda 's Weapon Skin < Apsara's Feather >[/p][p][/p][p]<Nora's Workshop>[/p][p][/p][p]Event Rule[/p][p]Use stones in the workshop to obtain score, Get up to 6 rounds of rewards provided by Nora[/p][p]Different Modification Stone will provide different amount of points[/p][p]Accumulative point reward can be obtained up to 6 rounds[/p][p][/p][p]Expected Event Duration[/p][p]2025-08-01 ~ 2025-08-31 12:00[/p][p][/p][p]<Sanguine Rites>[/p][p][/p][p]Event Rule[/p][p]Duration the Event, every【Sanguine Summon】will gain point, accumulate point to obtain massive pts reward. Event reward can be claimed up to 6 rounds[/p][p]This event will have server/Cross server ranking, and will provide related ranking reward (The Heart of Summon leaderboard will be replaced)[/p][p][/p][p]Expected Event Duration[/p][p]After Upate ~ 2025-08-13 12:00[/p][p][/p][p]<The Sakura Season I>[/p][p][/p][p]Event Rule[/p][p]During the Event, consume FP will have chance to drop event coin「Sakura Emblem」. 「Sakura Emblem」can be used to exchange various reward on event shop.[/p][p][/p][p]Expected Event Duration[/p][p]2025-08-01 8:00 ~ 2025-08-07 12:00[/p][p][/p][p]<Blaze the Trail>[/p][p][/p][p]Event Rule[/p][p]During the event period, every 1 FP commander consume will gain 1 event point, accumulate point to certain amount will gain stage reward, there will be 7 stage, up to 6 rounds.[/p][p]Single-server and Cross-server leaderboard will be set on this event, rewards will be distributed based on the total event points accumulated during the event.[/p][p][/p][p]Expected Event Duration[/p][p]2025-08-01 08:00 - 2025-08-07 12:00[/p][p][/p][p]<Fusion Miracle>[/p][p][/p][p]Event Rule[/p][p]During the Event, players can obtain massive Warp Scroll, Alchemical Dust, SS blackguard and precious Coin as reward by completing a serial of modification stone fusion task[/p][p][/p][p]Expected Event Duration[/p][p]2025-08-08 8:00 ~ 08-14 12:00[/p][p][/p][p]<Altar Ceremony>[/p][p]Event Rule[/p][p]During the event period, finish serial task to obtain massive reward, extra reward will be provided after finish all tasks[/p][p][/p][p]Expected Event Duration[/p][p]2025-08-08 8:00 ~ 2025-08-14 12:00[/p][p][/p][p]<Blacktide Frontline>[/p][p][/p][p]Blacktide Frontline is a limited-time trial. During the Event period, The commander has to challenge boss with 4 blackguards with self-decided difficulty[/p][p][/p][p]Event Rule[/p][p]The boss has a specific weakness which appropriate Blackguard can take advantage of[/p][p]The challenge of all difficulties cost 100 AP[/p][p]The trial is limited to 180 sec. If whole team faints in battle or exceed the time, challenge fails[/p][p]If kill the leader within the time limit, commander will win score and drop rewards from boss[/p][p]The more bonus drops will be given at higher difficulties, massive modification stone will be awarded.[/p][p]Each difficulty has its own leaderboard and will provide ranking reward（Each leaderboard will have level limit, the rule is similar to Primeval Gate Leaderboard）During this round, there will also be cross-server leaderboard[/p][p]There is also score for each participation. Bonus rewards and score ranking rewards will be given based on the accumulated score, including modification stone, SS blackguard Shard and precious coin[/p][p][/p][p]Expected Event Duration[/p][p]2025-08-08 8:00 - 2025-08-14 12:00[/p][p][/p][p]<Angel Heart–Forgetting>[/p][p][/p][p]New tasks related to the Forgetting have been added to Angel Heart. Completing them will grant rewards such as Sanguine Stone, Enhancement Stone Chests, and Blackguard Casting Chest. Players who have already met the requirements will have the tasks auto-completed.[/p][p][/p][p]<Progression and Stage Adjustments>[/p][p][/p][p]1. Misty Mountains now extends to Stage 1450. First-time clears grant Bound Gold and Sanguine Stone.[/p][p]2. Greatly increased the AFK EXP efficiency from clearing Normal Exploration Stages and Misty Mountains. (After the adjustment, reaching Stage 1500 is expected to take around 40 days with normal progression.)[/p][p]3. Unlock conditions for Oblivion Places have been adjusted — clearing Normal Exploration Stages now unlocks Oblivion Places –Howling Snowfield. Level requirements across all Oblivion Places stages have been lowered.[/p][p]4. Stage 751 of Misty Mountains now unlocks after clearing Oblivion Places – Sealed Land and reaching 10% exploration progress.[/p][p]5. Unlock condition for Journey Story– Normal Difficulty has been updated: now requires Yggdrasil Level 900, clearing Oblivion Places – Sealed Land, and 10% exploration progress.[/p][p][/p][p]<Event & Front Adjustments>[/p][p][/p][p]1. New currency added: Bound Gold (functions the same as regular gold, but cannot be traded).[/p][p]2. Some SS Fragment rewards from events and Everwinter Land have been replaced with Bound Gold, Locking Stones, Rotate Stone, Stones and others.[/p][p]3. SS and SP Blackguard faction upgrades now require corresponding Yggdrasil Level.[/p][p]4. Upgrading SP Blackguard factions now grants additional all-stat bonuses.[/p][p]5. Reset for SP Blackguards will be introduced in a future update.[/p][p][/p][p]<Guild Ascension Adjustment>[/p][p]Due to the changes in leveling speed, Guild Ascension will be adjusted as follows:[/p][p]1. Guild Ascension now requires reaching Yggdrasil Level 1150 (expected to be reached in about 20 days under normal progression).[/p][p]2. Ascension skill caps will now scale with Yggdrasil Level. (This change is expected to take effect in the mid-August update. notes.title: Patch Notes of May 28
notes.content:
Dear Commander:
We plan to start update maintenance on 15:00, May 28 (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to take 120 - 240 minutes.
*Please pay attention to the community and in-game rolling announcements for specific times.

After the maintenance, please update the client to the latest version before start the game.

During the maintenance, the players will be forcibly disconnected and unable to login. Please logout before the maintenance to avoid any data loss.

The following is the introduction of update contents:


[h2]【New Blackguard】[/h2]
<New SP Fire Type Support Blackguard> - Twinkle Palette, Miluie
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/64cb37083ffc03c649a49e03cb1dad1f26be49ec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/9a4fe505eae11da1cfa08173cf1ac0f612b69a69.png[/img]
[h2]【Elemental Force—Lightning】[/h2]
Limited-time Lightning type SP exclusive banner now available！
Duration: After Update ~ 2025.06.25 12:00
SP included: Komori / Ying / Nyanko / Seraphia / Epona
When hitting the jackpot, you will randomly obtain one of the SP Blackguards (with priority given to those who have not reached the maximum Sanguine Level).


[h2]【New Function】[/h2]

<Trading Hall>
New Material Trade: Enchanting Materials
These materials will be bound upon purchase and are sold in bundles. Please pay attention to the quantity when purchasing.
Required level for purchase: Yggdrasil Lv. 700

<Character Interaction Optimization>
To resolve the conflict between stocking interaction and camera movement, we've updated the mouse controls in the character skin interface. The new controls are as follows:
-Hold Left Click: Now exclusively used to drag character stockings (if available). No longer affects camera movement.
-Scroll Wheel: Zoom in/out. Hold the wheel and drag to continuously rotate the character.
-Left/Right: Rotate the character、Up/Down: Adjust vertical view angle.

<Angel Heart– New “Summit of Mist” Missions>
-Mission Details: Clear the Misty Mountains within the time limit to earn large amounts of Sanguine Stones and Diamonds.
-This mission unlocks after clearing Chapter 14 of Normal Exploration and remains available for 30 days.

[h2]【Limited-time Spending Rewards】[/h2]
Duration: After Update ~ 2025.06.25 12:00
Complete event spending requirements to obtain the following skins and more rewards:
100,000 Points: Commander's Skin < Chief Lecturer > ，with an added option to put on or take off the outfit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/7e43e3ea1908a43a54b6b2b69b957dcf056ee69c.png[/img]
1,000,000 Points: Supreme Skin Chest (Pick one of the skin from some of the past Limited-time Spending Rewards)


[h2]【New Gears】[/h2]
<New Casting Gears>
Added the following exclusive casting gear for the Blackguards. The casting formula price is Blacktide Medal x50
Juliet: Scarlet Grace


[h2]【Academy Cup S21 Season】[/h2]
Season duration: June 01, 2025 ~ June 29, 2025
Participating in the Academy Cup competition, the top-ranked commanders will obtain the following rewards:
Exclusive Avatar Frame: Honey Pearl: Longing Heart. Honey Pearl: Blueberry Ring. Honey Pearl: Cute Talk. Honey Pearl: Sugar Dream
Exclusive Title: Pastel Doodle


[h2]【Everwinter Land】[/h2]
[Everwinter Land] Season 49 and 50 is about to start. Due to the blessing of Fire, Fire type heroes will enjoy additional combat ability improvements in the battle of [Everwinter Land].


[h2]【Events】[/h2]

<New 8 Days Sign-in>

【Dance of Searing Blaze】
Qualification Activation：2025-05-31~2025-06-07，the sign-in event will end on June 14th, 2025

Day1：Warp Scroll *15
Day2：Adding Stone *125
Day3：Warp Scroll *15
Day4：Elimination Stone *170
Day5：Warp Scroll *15
Day6：Mercurial Stone *50
Day7：Eternal Grimoire Leaf *45
Day8：Chuchu’s Canvas

【Soul&Blood】
Qualification Activation：2025-06-09~2025-06-16，the sign-in event will end on June 23th, 2025

Day1：Warp Scroll *15
Day2：Mercurial Stone *125
Day3：Warp Scroll *15
Day4：Adding Stone *170
Day5：Warp Scroll *15
Day6：Elimination Stone *50
Day7：Grimoire Reset Stone *1
Day8：Floaty Party


<Lottery Event - Sasha Luo's Weapon Skin>
Duration: After Update ~ 2025.06.25 12:00
Introduction: By consuming <Lucky Charm> in the Lottery Event, you have a chance to obtain Sasha Luo 's weapon skin < AstroLuv > and other rich prize.

<Lottery Re-run - Juliet's Weapon Skin>
Duration: After Update ~ 2025.06.25 12:00
Introduction: By consuming <Emblem of Luck Essence> in the Lottery Re-run, you have a chance to obtain Juliet's weapon skin < Aureate Blaze > and other rich prize.

<Lottery Re-run - Additional Pool for Heliina's Weapon Skin!>
Missed the skins from past Lottery events and their reruns? No worries! A new rerun for past skins is available now.
Duration: After Update ~ 2025.06.25 12:00
Introduction: By consuming <Emblem of Luck Essence> in the Lottery Re-run, you have a chance to obtain the following skins and other rich prize:
Heliina 's Weapon Skin < Melody of Snowmelting >

<Nora's Workshop>

Event Rule
Use stones in the workshop to obtain score, Get up to 6 rounds of rewards provided by Nora
Different Modification Stone will provide different amount of points
Accumulative point reward can be obtained up to 6 rounds

Expected Event Duration
2025-06-01 ~ 2025-06-30 12:00

<Sanguine Rites>

Event Rule
Duration the Event, every【Sanguine Summon】will gain point, accumulate point to obtain massive pts reward. Event reward can be claimed up to 6 rounds
This event will have server/Cross server ranking, and will provide related ranking reward (The Heart of Summon leaderboard will be replaced)

Expected Event Duration
After Upate ~ 2025-06-11 12:00

<The Sakura Season I>

Event Rule
During the Event, consume FP will have chance to drop event coin「Sakura Emblem」. 「Sakura Emblem」can be used to exchange various reward on event shop.

Expected Event Duration
2025-06-01 8:00 ~ 2025-06-07 12:00

<Blaze the Trail>

Event Rule
During the event period, every 1 FP commander consume will gain 1 event point, accumulate point to certain amount will gain stage reward, there will be 7 stage, up to 6 rounds.
Single-server and Cross-server leaderboard will be set on this event, rewards will be distributed based on the total event points accumulated during the event.

Expected Event Duration
2025-06-01 08:00 - 2025-06-07 12:00

<Fusion Miracle>

Event Rule
During the Event, players can obtain massive Warp Scroll, Alchemical Dust, SS blackguard and precious Coin as reward by completing a serial of modification stone fusion task

Expected Event Duration
2025-06-08 8:00 ~ 06-14 12:00

<Altar Ceremony>
Event Rule
During the event period, finish serial task to obtain massive reward, extra reward will be provided after finish all tasks

Expected Event Duration
2025-06-08 8:00 ~ 2025-06-14 12:00

<Blacktide Frontline>

Blacktide Frontline is a limited-time trial. During the Event period, The commander has to challenge boss with 4 blackguards with self-decided difficulty

Event Rule
The boss has a specific weakness which appropriate Blackguard can take advantage of
The challenge of all difficulties cost 100 AP
The trial is limited to 180 sec. If whole team faints in battle or exceed the time, challenge fails
If kill the leader within the time limit, commander will win score and drop rewards from boss
The more bonus drops will be given at higher difficulties, massive modification stone will be awarded.
Each difficulty has its own leaderboard and will provide ranking reward（Each leaderboard will have level limit, the rule is similar to Primeval Gate Leaderboard）During this round, there will also be cross-server leaderboard
There is also score for each participation. Bonus rewards and score ranking rewards will be given based on the accumulated score, including modification stone, SS blackguard Shard and precious coin

Expected Event Duration
2025-06-08 8:00 - 2025-06-14 12:00


[h2]【BUG Fixes and Other Optimization】[/h2]

< Void Chasm >
-Abandoning a battle no longer reduces your stage progress
-New Reward Slot: Unlocks after clearing Floor 15+ four times in a week. Selecting this reward grants 15x Eternal Codex Fragment (S1). Collect 40 fragments to choose one Void Chasm S1 Eternal Grimoire.
-You can now repeatedly challenge any Void Chasm stage (up to your highest floor cleared this season).

<Others>
-Optimized guild quest order and merged task display
-Fixed an issue where the Horcrux Spirit of Ling failed to correctly apply its bonus damage effect to enemies considered to be in a frozen state

After the update, all in-game paid consumables will be unified under the new currency, Yog Points. The original currency held by Commanders can be exchanged for Yog Points at a certain ratio, and the purchasing power of the original currency will remain unchanged! All paid activities that consume Yog Points will be counted towards the cumulative recharge rewards.

[h2]【New Gameplay】[/h2]

[h3]【Gold Consignment Hall】[/h3]
Welcome to Arklance — a world full of opportunities and good fortune. Here, you can earn Gold by completing challenges in the Gold Valley. Afterward, you can list this Gold for sale at the Consignment Hall. Once the transaction is successful, the Gold in your possession will be converted into Gold Tickets. Finally, you can use these Gold Tickets to redeem various rare equipment and items at the Gold Ticket Hall. Wishing all Commanders abundant wealth and endless good luck in Arklance!

[h3]【Guild Ascension】[/h3]
Consume "Gold" and "Guild Coin" to enhance the attributes of all Black Guards. A maximum of 45 upgrades can be made per week, with the upgrade count resetting every Sunday at 08:00 AM.

[h3]【Journey Story】[/h3]
New stages, "The Phantom of Orient" and "My Heart Is Fire", have been added to Blacktide Difficulty 3. The "Handguard" dropped from these stages may have the "Tradeable" attribute, allowing it to be sold in the upcoming auction house system once implemented.

[h3]【Golden Valley】[/h3]
Completing Chapter 14 of the main story unlocks the "Golden Valley " stage in the "Trial Labyrinth ". Challenge the greedy Goblins to earn tradeable Gold. Higher stage difficulty grants more Gold, and the "Endless Fortune " skill in the "Guild Ascension " system boosts Gold acquisition efficiency.


[h2]【Guild War S1: Origin Season】[/h2]

Guild members across servers can now battle simultaneously!
The Guild War will start at 12:00 every Monday and Thursday, and will last for 48 hours each time. (Server time)
Members who remain in their Guild for over 48 hours, reach Guild Level 10, and achieve a Yggdrasil Level of 400+ can deploy their own defensive team.
The president and vice president can designate these members who have deployed defensive team into [defense towers].
When the guild's defense configuration meets the requirements, it can automatically participate in the Guild War.
Those in the towers will be able to strike the opponent’s towers when the Guild War begins. Winner of each strike will be rewarded with [destruction points].
At the end of the war, the guild with the highest destruction points will be declared the victor.
Members who participated will receive rewards based on the Guild’s ranking, the War’s outcome, and the number of battles they engaged in.

notes.title: Brief Introduction of New Mode
notes.content:
Dear Commander, in this update, we have brought you a new high-difficulty gear sets looting gameplay mode - [Journey Story].

The SP-Blackguard exclusive story mode in [Journey Story] is divided into [Story Experience Mode] and [Standard Mode].

[Story Experience Mode] provides commanders who are in the early stages of the game to experience the exclusive story of the SP Blackguard, please note that this mode is not include Gear Sets Looting level.

When the commander chooses the final level in [Standard Mode] to challenge, depending on the difficulty of the final level selected, there will be a different chance of dropping an ancient sets that the highest quality is <Eternal>, which are exclusive to the level.

It should be noted that because the final level in [Standard Mode] are extremely difficult, the commander needs to meet the following two requirements at the same time: [b]<Yggdrasil level of 1300 or above>[/b], and the progress of [b]<Oblivion Place – Deep in Seal> reaching 100%[/b] so that you can unlock the challenge entrance of [Standard Mode].

The following is the introduction of the sets and attributes dropped from the final level of <The Phantom of Orient>.

[h2]<The Phantom of Orient> Ancient Sets and Set Effects[/h2]

[b]【Netherflame Swordsman】[/b]、[b]【Crimson Neon Slayer】[/b]、[b]【Impasse Wanderer】[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/d388413bda3e695eb55876fe9b0e6e4bbfcb26fd.png[/img]

Depending on the difficulty of the selected level, there will be a different chance of dropping ancient sets of the following qualities.

Quality of ancient set: <below the Immortal, Immortal, Mythic, Eternal>

Ancient Set equipment has 1 main affix + 2/3/4 random sub-affixes. An Ancient Set of different qualities determine the number of random affixes.
Immortal quality and below: 1 main affix + 2 random sub-affixes (the affixes are not repeated when the gear is dropped)
Mythical quality: 1 main affix + 3 random sub-affixes (the affixes are not repeated when the gear is dropped)
Eternal quality: 1 main affix + 4 random sub-affixes (the affixes are not repeated when the gear is dropped)

The main affixes and sub-affixes that can be obtained from different gear slots of ancient sets

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/b79f7530def05f6f681ebf52705935a5601ea066.png[/img]

[h2]About the Enhancement and Break-up of Ancient Sets[/h2]

[h3]About the Enhancement[/h3]
The quality of the ancient set gear is fixed when it is dropped. The quality cannot be improved through the Upgrade Stone, but the attributes of affixes can still be improved through equipment enhancement function.
Each quality of ancient sets can be enhanced by consuming [Lura] and [Alchemical Dust].
The enhancement is 100% successful. After enhancement, the enhancement level of the corresponding Ancient Set will be increased, and the value of the affixes will be changed.
After the enhancement level reaches the corresponding upper limit level 20, it can no longer be enhanced.

[h3]About the Break-up[/h3]
Ancient set of any quality can be break-up. After break-up, the equipment will disappear and be converted into a corresponding amount of Alchemical Dust.
For Ancient set that has been enhanced, a certain proportion of the  materials will be returned after break-up ([Lura] and [Alchemical Dust])

notes.title: 【BLACKGUARD PROFILE】Foxy Archduchess-Komori
notes.content:
[h3]【SP Lightening Support Blackguard】Foxy Archduchess-Komori[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/58d3ea847bc3db15ffc8e5d5d6d50f4ae114af5a.png[/img]



[Alias and Name]: Foxy Archduchess - Mochizuki Komori
[Gender]: Female
[Race]: Beast Blood
[Birthday]: March 7th
[Birthplace]: Senblen
[Specific height/weight]: 168cm/69kg
[Specialty]: Charming; Lying
[Favorite things]: Thunder; Interesting People; Sincerity
[Hate things]: Candy; Boring People; Lies


---------------
[b]Character Story[/b]
The fox-spirit clan, as known as Yoko clan, had allied with the Empire many years ago. In the early years, the Empire was extremely courteous to the fox-spirit clan, the land and the title were given to them. Only because fox spirit was considered auspicious at that time. Komori, as the daughter of the archduke of this clan, had been favored by all.

But the good times didn't last long. As the Empire declined, people's attitude towards this clan changed dramatically. They were blamed for the corrupt of the Empire. Rumours spread that the archduke plotted a rebellion secretly.

Komori and her family were imprisoned for this crime they did not commit. Although the Empire had found no clues that they're plotting a rebellion, they were not paroled until Komori's parents, the archduke and the archduchess died. Komori was excessively disappointed for treatment in prison. 

After released, she left clan's territory in a thunderstorm night.

Soon thereafter, the fox-spirit clan began to decline, and their territory was invaded by barbarians for a long time.

Almost everyone thought the territory was unable to be recaptured. But Komori returned and led an army to repulsed the barbarians.

Her merits made the Empire to restore her family's title. Komori accepted the reward with a smile and a promise, "I'll make this place a true paradise."

She just smiled, with no more emotions. Seemed like all her emotions had vanished in that thunderstorm night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/37a58a159ffdc0eb4d1a6590891eba5f4db65b40.png[/img]

notes.title: 【BLACKGUARD PROFILE】Legendary Dragon - Vina
notes.content:
[h2]【SP Frost Striker】Legendary Dragon - Vina
[/h2]

[Alias and Name]：Legendary Dragon - Vina

[Gender]: Female

[Race]: Dragonborn

[Birthday]: December 24th

[Birthplace]: Hidden Mountain Ranges

[Specific height/weight]: 171cm/52kg

[Specialty]: Flying; Heavy Lifting; Combat Skills

[Favorite things]: Meat, any meat; Cats; Warm People

[Hate things]: Vegetables, any vegetables; Rainy Days; Tongue Twisters

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/766aa49beb4466fc01f7009894be9b5dbb7b7dcc.png[/img]

[h3]Blackguard Story[/h3]

Vina was urgently called back to her hometown. She never expected to meet that girl again. Her sister, Wingless Dragonborn, Chilo.

Chilo was judged as a cursed vermin by the Immortal Dragon when she was born. She stood accused of parricide years ago for she killed her foster parents. Thus, she was punished. Her horn was broken and she was threw down from the cliff to feed the beasts.

Almost everyone thought Chilo was died. However, she's alive and she came back. She decided to got revenge on all the dragonborns. Her first aim was the Immortal Dragon.

Vina engaged in combat with her. In their battle, Vina was on the back foot. And Chilo didn't seem to feel pain, her attack was continuous, vicious and crazy, yet she avoid Vina's vitals on purpose. It seemed that she gave Vina a break just beacuse she wanted to torture Vina a few more times.

In order to guard the sleeping Immortal Dragon, Vina fended off Chilo's slash with her body. It almost killed her.

At the same time, the Immortal Dragon awoke. It blessed Vina's dragon blood and saved her life. The blessing blood gave Vina a new power and with this power, she beat off Chilo successfully.




[h3]Vina’s Memory[/h3]

"You cursed jerk." That's many clansmen called Chilo.

Vina hated that name. Every time she heard someone called Chilo that, she would cover Chilo's ears and glared at them. Chilo was considerate. When she went out, she would bring back gifts for Vina, such as shiny stones, flowers, and little frogs. Chilo was persuadable. Vina would listen to the reason why she was angry, and help her to defend. And if it was her mistake, Vina would criticize her. At that time, Chilo always held her arms and promised in a small voice that she would never do it again.

Chilo was Vina's best friend. Chilo was Vina's family.

Chilo wasn't a cursed jerk.

At least Vina used to think so.

But Chilo destroyed their family. She killed their foster parents.

It's first time Vina couldn't understand her.

It's first time Vina couldn't listen to her reason.

She couldn't think. She couldn't feel. She couldn't cry.

A sudden flash of insight appeared in Vina's thought -- it proved so, Chilo was cursed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/0e2daeb8cfafa02040cbd44a6d1b2e037587efb6.png[/img]

notes.title: 【Blackguard Profile】Coltish Artillerist-Meine&Salvia Fairy-Cacau
notes.content:
[h3][SP Mystic Blackguard] Coltish Artillerist-Meine[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/393fe5341b3965542d9aaf91d08ea2b427a3ca47.png[/img]


[b]Basic Information[/b]

[Alias and Name]: Coltish Artillerist - Meine

[Gender]: Female

[Race]: Human

[Birthday]: July 27

[Birthplace]: Valoia Empire

[Height/Weight]:163cm/45kg

[Specialty]: Alchemy; Music; Ikebana

[Favorite Things]: Black tea; Dragon; Obscure music

[Hate Things]: Overelaborate etiquette; Aristocratic formalwear; Being disciplined



[b]Blackguard Story
[/b]
Meine was born in a small and successful merchant family in Valois Empire.Meine growth should have been carefree, and she do have a short and happy childhood intoxicated by alchemy. However This happiness did not last long, and soon her parents were not satisfied with the mere accumulation of wealth, and had the idea of crossing classes and becoming nobility.

When this wish passed to the hands of the Meine, it has been fanatical almost twisted, parents invited etiquette teachers to discipline her life in all aspects in order to make a gentle noble lady.

When she was about to drown in this sea of love, Meine grabbed the last life-saving rope at hand - the joint research invitation letter sent by "Genius Alchemist" Nora.

snatches out of the "door", Literally, in order to get rid of the shackles named "home", she even tore down the door of her own house - in the pursuit of freedom, Meine with an almost imperceptible miss, constantly moving forward. After several turns she arrived at  Blackguard Academy, she became a blackguard through the Sanguine Ceremony.

Event though she preserved an appearance of nonchalance, But years away from home the yearning hidden in her heart, still make her eager for love, which is why when she faces the misbehaving parents at the Sanguine Ceremony the mask of indifference has appeared a little crack


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/5cdd05d376b8ed261dba054c38763a69b98c5e53.png[/img]


===================================


[h3][SP Support Blackguard] Salvia Fairy - Cacau[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/9edcf72214046a27a009f25c8a8d5db56f32f839.png[/img]


[b]Basic Information[/b]

[Alias and Name]: Salvia Fairy - Cacau

[Gender]: Female

[Race]: Fairy

[Birthday]: February 1

[Birthplace]: Spiriterra

[Height/Weight]: 60cm (including antennae)/8kg

[Specialty]: "Just Execution"; Animal communication

[Favorite Things]: Music box; Cat; Seedling

[Hate Things]: Rainy day; Lie; Boring time



[b]Blackguard Story[/b]

simple-minded romantic Arson Fairy.

"I... I'm here for Lara! "

The first time Cacau arrived at Blackguard Academy in Arklance, she announced her purpose directly.

As a Pyromanic Sprite, Cacau never suppresses her nature of firing, however, she is an anomaly in her tribe. Compared to other Pyromanic Sprites, she has an extra innate sense of justice.

Because of her sense of justice, Cacau began her path of finding Lara. When she packed her bag and decided to began her journey, the other Pyromanic Sprites felt relief.

She chases justice like moths to a flame, she decided to join Blackguard Academy simply because Academy Master cleverly described his mission as "upholding justice." after she joined Blackguard Academy, Cacau's actions are almost driven by the "sense of justice", but her nature is still the Arson Fairy, this justice if not guided, it will be like a wanton flame, warm, but a little attention will burn everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/b2654870498a1f7921c73f7f76f51c428ad0ec60.png[/img]

notes.content:
[h2]【New Blackguard】[/h2]

[h3]Vanguard of Valkyrie - Edelle[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/82758fa86d67e4340d09dd0a31c824f0943e7472.png[/img]

[Alias and Name]: Vanguard of Valkyrie - Edelle
[Gender]: Female
[Race]: Human
[Birthdate]: May 6
[Birthplace]: Holy Castle
[Height/Weight]: 168cm/46kg
[Specialty]: Fast Reading, Detecting, Lip-language
[Favorite things]: Pocket Watch, Chivalric Literature, Clean Room
[Hate Things]: The Gossip, Joke, Deserter
·················································································

Edelle’s ancestors were the nobility of the old empire. Her family was praised by The Black Emperor as “Imperial Rampart” for their outstanding achievements in war and military talents. This title was the highest tribute to a family. And it meant that as long as her family exist, the glory of the empire would never fall

However, a hundred years ago, the Black Tide destroyed everything. Although her family survived, the old empire was gone, the “Imperial Rampart” was pulled down. The glory and honor of her family vanished overnight

During these hundred years, her family are still obsessed with the glory of the past. They regard the restoration of the old empire as a family’s aspiration for generations. Edelle was born in such a family. Although she did not witness the glory of the old empire - she knew it only from her family's narrative - she also has a same aspiration as her families. She was trained in the military academy from a young age, and later successfully joined the military police. Then she arrived at Blackguard Academy as stationed military police

In general, the blackguards are not willing to communicate with stationed military police in daily life. But Edelle attracts a lot of them

You cannot find a blackguard who dislikes this ice beauty in Academy. Edelle was always asked about her experiences, but no one could open her heart

She only answered one question about herself once: why did she join the military police?
“It’s my family honor.” She said, “and it also is my duty.”

The maiden who calls herself the “God’s Scioness" seems to have existed since time immemorial. She has awakened from a long slumber, nothing is known of her origins and her actions.

For some unknown reason, Florentia and Sutherland were born in the same body, their soul and blood entangled with each other.

In the darkest nights, one can often see Florentia holding the "Book of Yog", her red eyes are faintly shining with a blood-like luster. A deep and sonorous rumble comes out of her mouth, dark and turbid, but listening carefully it seems to resemble some sort of a language.

If someone confronted her the next day about it, she would seem absolutely perplexed, stating that she can’t remember anything happening the night before.

notes.title: [Book of Yog]Version Review and Future Outlook
notes.content:
[b][h2]Introduction[/h2][/b]
Hello everyone, time is flying by and suddenly I realized that I haven't talked to you all for a long time.
It's an evening of an usual overtime day, and everyone is busy with the update on the end of April, but still I want to take some time out of my busy schedule to communicate with you all.

Since February, after a few months of integration, the new students have gradually integrated into the team, and we are finally able to ensure twice a month update frequency, while still having time for reflection and upgrades to the game.

In long term, we hope that the game will have an all-round improvement in content experience this year, which in one word that we want to make the Book of Yog more like a pure [game], we want to have a regular experience closer to RPG games, we want to build a ample storyline and design, we want to add a better combat operating experience to the core battles, and we want to greatly enhance the fun of collecting and idle treasures.

In fact, with the current achievement of "The Book of Yog", 99% of game teams (allow us to laugh at ourselves) will choose to seek stability and will choose more commercially conservative market strategies, which may temporarily bring us more revenue but cannot bring us closer to our dreams and ambitions, so we still want to try to break the original framework, although these efforts are not reflected in the current version, but we actually put a lot of effort into it, and it is like planting a seed, hopefully it could grow some new shoots about this year.

Next, we will briefly talk about the development plan of the conceptual modules (welfare and system optimization will continue, so I won't describe too much in this post):
[h3][b]Large treasure loot map, hero value balance, equipment amplification& equipment (runes, black stone) content extension, female Commander, the main storyline[/b][/h3]

[b]
[h3]1. Code Name: Treasure Hunting Relic[/h3][/b]
We are planing to launch a large PVE game in July, the design concept is that players can loot treasure and fight in a series of levels. (Inspired by Diablo 2)
The relics will drop the ultimate equipment of the game (runes, gems)
Players need to conquer the relics step by step, choose the most suitable route depending on your team power, fully explore the relics during limited time. Enhancing gear, character, collecting item will become more important before expedition.

[LUK] attribute will become important, it will determine whether certain precious equipment may drop, will also somehow affect your loot drop in the relics.

[Mythical Monsters] There are various mythical creatures in the ruins, find and defeat them, different creatures have different loot, commanders need to balance a good route with their strength.

[Story] There will be not only battles in the ruins, but also stories and eggs.

Scene production upgrade】We will improve the scene design process, presenting players with a higher quality design, not only in the art response, but a full range of design details



[b][h3]2. Blackguard Value Balance[/h3][/b]
We will continue to adjust all S Blackguards to improve the balance and playability of the game, after the adjustment of S Blackguards will not greatly weaker than the SS Blackguards
At the same time, we will increase and enrich more dimensions of combat mechanics, summoning flow, healing team, shield counter, poison, etc., gradually enrich the combat play style
At present, the completion of the program is about 60%, may be completed in June to July.



[b][h3]3. Equipment Amplification & Equipment (Runes, Gems) Content Extension[/h3][/b]
Some equipment (for example: Blackguard exclusive equipment) will be able to further amplified, currently our sketchy idea is that amplification will require the consumption of drawings, materials, and need to build a [perfect] equipment (equipment quality, affix level, enhancement level and other conditions to reach the perfect requirements, as equipment [perfect])
In order to let players experience more fun of equipment collection and combination, we will improve the speed of equipment (runes, black stones) content addition, and improve the quality of design. At the same time we are sure that they are available to any player.



[b][h3]4. Female Commander[/h3][/b]
The change for the female commander is roughly divided into two phases
Phase 1 model and character setting replacement (around July-August)
Phase 2 replacement of new combat mechanics (can be hand-operated or automatic) with new talent tree system (no timetable yet)



[b][h3]5. Main Story:[/h3][/b]
We will upgrade the entire Story playout system to provide better game story and performance, it is a large and complex project, so no clear timeline can be given at this time. Since this is something that needs to be accumulated and has a certain amount of stock before it can be launched, so please be patient with us.



[b][h3]6. Others [/h3][/b]
We will continue to enrich the systems and gameplay within the guild, and due to time issues, we will dedicate an explanation to the guild module sometime in the future.



Last of all, thank you very much for your support of "Book of Yog", the game is currently in the [cocoon] period and is not sophisticated enough nor rich enough. But we believe that the most important thing for a team to succeed is the will and the heart; the will is the original impulse to do things well, the heart is the perseverance, so we believe it will finally come to the day to break the cocoon into a butterfly. We will definitely keep our promise and keep updating more and more interesting contents to make the game more and more fun.

notes.title: Preview of the Febraury's Schedule
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am C. The Lunar New Year Holiday has been over in the twinkling of an eye, we are now back on our busy work. 

    There's so many things we need to prepare at the beginning of the year, including the system development arrangement, preparing New Event, optimizing game expereience, producing new content. 
   However, I miss everyone so much and thinking that I have not reaching out to you for a long time, so I took some time out of my shcdule to write this article, in case I want to share current progress with you

  First of all, I will introduce the schedule about this month. Due to limited time and energy, many functions that players care about may not be implemented in a short time, such as equipment pre-set function, female commander and talent tree, etc.. We will try to launch as early as possible while ensuring quality, to bring a better experience to everyone

==============
[h3]Next I will briefly introduce some arrangement that players may care about:
[/h3]
   I am going to begin with new balckguard, I know some of you have waited her for a long time, but unfortunitely, depending on the remaining work-load, it might need to wait till the end of February to release, please be patient while we are working~（hearsay: the new blackguard will fill the profession lefted on the SS）
    

[b]New Event And Gameplay Design[/b]
After referring to lots of games, conbining with our game's actual situation,  we made a preliminary plan for future event. We hope that the future event can be updated and refreshed with an order, and the event content will be more inclined to resource consumption. Even the resource consumption will also be segmented, allowing all players to earn more rewards with careful arrangement

  For instance, if this round's event is AP related event, the next round might be diamond related, the one after next might be fragment consumption event.....the event will be rotated with order. If players find out that he cannot get all reward of this round, he can choose to deposit for one round and participate the next round to get all reward, so that everyone could get all reward with rational resource allocation(Leak: Next event will be AP related, save if needed)

[b]Blackmarket Adjustment[/b]
  We are planing to adjust the refresh consumption rule, the rule after adjustment will be : First 8 times refreshing will consume 400 coins, therefore, the cost of each refresh doubles, and the redeemable amount of all items except equipment and Tome of the chosen will be doubled
  The Dried Meat will be replaced by Smoked Meatloaf, 1 available per refresh
[b]
Weakness System Design[/b]
   We are going to introduce a brand new design into our game, But how to do it is a difficult subject, we need to consider monster animation, camera, Ui, and consider either or not to add Hero weakness related featuer. Fortunitely currently we already have a frame about how to design, plaining to release in game within this month, we will also share more detail in the future announcement

=======
    Looking back to the very beginning, the Book of Yog has been online for nearly half year, in fact, the results are way beyond my expectations. As a small team, I understand that the team has a lot of shortcomings and the game content is not plenty, but we are so grateful that so many players to accompany with us. In the New Year, we will listen to our players more carefully and bring you better game content.
    
   At the end, I sincerely want to say thank you for your support to the book of Yog. In the New Year, best wishes to everyone!

notes.title: 【Book of Yog】 Brand New Year Overview
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the brand new year is coming, to be honest originally we are planing to communicate with you after the New Year Version, to talk about the current game situation, plan and process, but due to some reason, I have to move it up to now.

First at all, I want to say sorry to every players, due to the immaturity of our team, we did some thing impaper that makes player uncomfortable, we are not intended to do this, but the designer's lack of personal experience, players misunderstood and lack of operator's follow-up does bring lots of unhappy things to players.

I sincerely apologize for all controversy, and will introduce my design ideas of the future version in the above content

[h3]1. About the Feather Emblem Shop[/h3]
Due to the improper calculation, some item's price in the shop are actually higher than the previous round, we noticed it and have adjusted it down to the same level as the first round
 

[h3]Black market-Dried Meat adjustment[/h3]
The goal of pubilshing the notification are actually trying to collect players feedback, but because of unclear description, it seems to be an update announcement
The expected adjusted will be the following, if you have any suggestion or idea please feel free to let us know:

Dried Meat(10 AP)*3 will probably change to Smoked Meatloaf(50 AP)*1
The black market refresh price rule will be reconsidered, the price will not change for the first few refreshes, the maximum amount of some items (such as stones) will be increased accordingly, three card players will have the bonus of ancient coins.


[b]Here's where it stands, where it's planned, where it's going:[/b]

More benefits and more activity make the game more fun to play, improve the game balance to increase the diversity of heroes, expand the main story, strengthen the Commander 


[h3]
1. More benefits and activity[/h3]

Future events are planned in the way that combines resource consumption and new gameplay and will rotate regularly. As long as the player pays attention to stocking up and participating, any player can easily take all rewards. In this aspect, we will continue to explore and debug, so that the activity gradually became stable, regular and mature.

Continue to increase profits for three-card players

Optimize daily check-in rewards

Add more free bonus and Guild bonus design



[h3]2. Improve gameplay[/h3]

We are actually struggling about how to improve core game design right now. Yog is a multi-character game with a lot of DARK mechanics, we are walking on a way that none of other company has ever attempted, we are suffered from too many unkown factors.

As a designer, I always ask myself, "So what you can do is to make the the hero stronger and stronger?" "What's the fun while playing?" 90% of our peers won't experience the problem we encountered, especially big company. They all say things like "just make what come later stronger", "just spend more money on art design", "just concentrate on in game purchase experience", "only games like Genshin will need to provide more playable content", "only take care of people who pay".

As a person who eager to make a great game，I do not want to stay in a big company, what I want is that my game can bring pleasure to players. I know it is going to be a long and lonely way to go, and it highly possible to get nothing back, the progress will takes years. I know that innovation is a risky thing and you may lost all you have, no one will repsect your failure but laugh at you, but I throw myself into it still

In the future, we will enhance the level Stage Design and experience, increase strategy and combat power, and add the following mechanics and various expansions that involves a lot of factors

[b]
For example: add BOSS breaking mechanism[/b]

Later in the game, bosses will have different weaknesses, heroes will be given some attack characteristics, corresponding to the weakness to inflict additional effects on attacks; When player hits the BOSS by weak point, the defense value will be reduced. When the defense value is 0, the BOSS will break the defense. The BOSS will interrupt the current combat logic and fall into a coma. The damage dealt to the boss will have a high bonus. (After some time, the BOSS wakes up)

[b]There may be more than one BOSS weakness, which also causes some changes to the level mechanics[/b]

For example: the BOSS battle summons the guard monster, when the monster is alive, the BOSS's weakness is locking, one must destroy the guard to unclock the weakness point; Some bosses will change their weaknesses randomly depending on the battle

In the future, the design of the Commander's skill system will also be reconstructured and adjusted based on these. I will introduce the design related to the Commander in another section.


It may be trivial, but as a designer, I have to spend days and nights looking up stuff, dazing, drafting designs, ripping them up and starting over, and listening to players' complaint, "There's no substance," and I'm sorry we don't have the manpower to take care of everything.



[h3]3. About the Commander[/h3]

[b]Sure Content[/b]: There will be a revamp of the main character's skill system and a talent point system

[b]On the table:
[/b]
1. The male Commander quits the game stage and replaced by a female Commander (the team cannot handle the relevant art resources, skins, etc.)



2. Dual Class Talent System (similar to Grim Dawn)



[b]3. Commander battle mechanics[/b]

The Commander will have special ability points, temporarily called AP points

When the Commander cast a skill, it will cost AP, which is naturally restored, or a special skill from a partner, ultimate, etc

The fucntion of the Commander's skills in combat:

Accelerate getting into BOSS break defense

Some skills will have a break effect, which makes it easier for the BOSS to break in a crisis or at the moment you want

Increase output revenue

When the BOSS breaks, cost tons of AP to deal enough damage (2-3 times more damage when the BOSS is breaking).

Therefore, the Commander becames the balance point of the overall pace of the battle, and the proper allocation of AP becomes the key to the battle. (Of course, we will also gradually introduce better automatic decision features, the hanging element will not be weakened)


[b]4. Improve the combat performance of the Commander[/b]

- the Commander's action in battle may include multiple combo performances, even tetanic or floating effects (similar to Lost Ark, still being evaluated)



[b]5. The Commander can change part of the appearance model[/b]

Change the appearance of weapons, heads, etc


This is my current idea for the level combat and mechanics of the game. It may not be like that ideal, it may succeed, but my goal is to make the game more playable. I told myself when I give up my job in a big company that I would not compromise even if I tried and failed.

To be fair, Book of Yog is a P2W game. To be honest, I need it to feed my dream. After all, the growth of "Yog" and future planned games of the team cannot be live without substantial support, but I will try my best to make everyone feel more and more worthwhile. Although I know that the road is long and the team is small, the test team of any NetEase project is more than our whole team

Players ask me all the time, "Are you going to run away?" ", my heart is a little sad, think is "I know I will always go on, but in fact you may be difficult to accompany us for a long time".

For all the players who have played our games, I want to say thanks to you. Without your support, I could not keep going.

Therefore, there will be welfare and plot in the future, useless S heroes will be useful, and the young people in the team will become mature. I hope you will stay with us for a long time.

notes.title: Patch Notes of Jan. 16th Version
notes.content:
Dear Commander:

Thank you for your support to Book of Yog. In order to bring you a better gaming experience, we will open a new server: Asia_10 at 15:00 on Jan. 18th (UTC+8). The new server will have exclusive benefits, please pay attention to the official Discord Channel for details of the benefits.

=============
Dear Commander, the following is the introduction of the patch notes of the Jan. 16th version.
=============
Patch Notes:
[h3]New system - Rune system[/h3]
After clearing the 150th levels of the Misty Mountains, the rune system will be unlocked, and heroes of immortal quality and above will have rune slots
The runes are divided into main rune and sub rune. The main runes have edges in different colors, players need to combine the color to activate rune skills. The runes will provide some attributes
The sub runes will drop randomly from the 151st levels of the Misty Mountains, and the main runes will drop from the bosses in the high levels of the Misty Mountains. We will introduce more main rune designs in the future.
Main rune and Sub rune can be equipped on unlocked rune slots, the hero will gain stat when equipped

[b]Rune Skill Activation Rule[/b]
The edge of the main rune meets the combination requirement to activate skill
Around the Edges required for the main rune skill combination, the adjacent slot must equip sub rune of the same color (linking effect)

[h3]New Equipment Intelligent Modification System[/h3]

[h3]New Mode-Brave Trial[/h3]
Event Duration: Jan. 16th - Feb. 28th

[b]Event Information[/b]

The Remaining challenge time will be wiped after event ended

Runes temporarily supports most modification functions
New equipment intelligent modification system

notes.title: Server Maintenance & Patch Notes of Dec. 29th
notes.content:
Dear Commanders:

The Book of Yog will have an update maintenance on 14:30, Dec. 29th. (UTC+8) The maintenance is expected to take 60 - 180 minutes.

The maintenance will be a mandatory update. After the maintenance, please update the client to the latest version before start the game.

During the maintenance, the players will be forcibly disconnected and unable to login. Please logout before the maintenance to avoid any data loss.
====================
[h3]【New Event】-Endelyon's Wonderful Gift of Winter Veil[/h3]
December 25th is the time of year filled with blessings and joy for the residents of Arklance. On this day, they can forget the threat that looms beyond the Wall and enjoy this winter's blessing with food, gifts and good wishes.

For Endylyon, December 25th is not only her birthday, but also has another meaning for her. As an abandoned child adopted by Blackguard Academy, Endylyon has always been deeply grateful to the academy and the city. So, even on her own birthday, Endylyon would try to help others. In her words, she hopes to bring blessings to more people in the city.

And this year, for Endylyon, there was someone else, besides Nia and everyone else, who began to take a place in her heart.
"Well, I wonder if the commander will like my present... Learning to knit socks for the first time, I also asked Nia for a lot of advice, I wonder if you like it commander..."
The wings behind her are suddenly flapped, and it seems that Endylyon is in trouble to give you a gift of her own to show your gratitude for her care.
"No, no, no, Endylyon! Come on!"
Raising her tiny fist, energetic gave herself a timid, energetic cheer.
The girl has made up her mind to send her own gift, and the heart hidden in it ~

[h3]【New Blackguard】SS-tier Striker【Alice】[/h3]

When there are no enemy units within a range of 3 meters, Alice rushes to the nearest enemy target within 8 meters. And when Alice causes normal attack, she can release a shock wave of Netherblade to the front, causes physical damage equal to {X} of Physical Power to the enemies in the path.

[h3]【New Event】-Endelyon's Wonderful Gift of Winter Veil[/h3]
December 25th is the time of year filled with blessings and joy for the residents of Arklance. On this day, they can forget the threat that looms beyond the Wall and enjoy this winter's blessing with food, gifts and good wishes.

For Endylyon, December 25th is not only her birthday, but also has another meaning for her. As an abandoned child adopted by Blackguard Academy, Endylyon has always been deeply grateful to the academy and the city. So, even on her own birthday, Endylyon would try to help others. In her words, she hopes to bring blessings to more people in the city.

And this year, for Endylyon, there was someone else, besides Nia and everyone else, who began to take a place in her heart.
"Well, I wonder if the commander will like my present... Learning to knit socks for the first time, I also asked Nia for a lot of advice, I wonder if you like it commander..."
The wings behind her are suddenly flapped, and it seems that Endylyon is in trouble to give you a gift of her own to show your gratitude for her care.
"No, no, no, Endylyon! Come on!"
Raising her tiny fist, energetic gave herself a timid, energetic cheer.
The girl has made up her mind to send her own gift, and the heart hidden in it ~

notes.title: Server Maintenance & Patch Notes of Dec. 8th
notes.content:
Dear Commanders:

The Book of Yog will start an update maintenance on 14:00, Dec. 8th. (UTC+8) The maintenance is expected to take 60 - 180 minutes.

The maintenance will be a mandatory update. After the maintenance, please update the client to the latest version before start the game.

During the maintenance, the players will be forcibly disconnected and unable to login. 

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3]New Event-【Nia's Private Collection】[/h3]
[b]■Event Duration[/b]
Dec. 8th, 2022 - Jan. 1st, 2023
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/f9f8953c0e28899eea9990cbb35ec9318cb05e47.png[/img]
[b]■Event Introdauction[/b]
As the provost of the college,  Nia has always kept the college in in perfect order with her excellent ability and high standards, and one can always find Nia's elegant appearance all over the college.

As a reward for her own work, whenever Nia 'cleans',  she will collect the occasional lost property she found and kept it in her private collection.

In addition to their admiration for the superior maid,Sometimes blackguards also wondered what Nia had picked up today that made her smile so bright.

Even as a commander,when you occasionally return from the battlefield with Nia together, you would wonder what the smiling Nia had collected today as well. But would it be rude to ask Nia directly?

"Commander, you seem to be interested in my private collection. Well, Nia will allow you to pick something you favored from my collection~

Huh? You ask Why? Well... Think of it as a reward for the commander's hard work. Ha ha, maybe the reward includes Nia myself?"

When you look at Nia with a sly smile, you realize that seems like you have become a part of Nia's private collection?

[b]■Event Information[/b]
Players can obtain event token 【Feather Emblem】by consuming FP and completing daily and weekly tasks（Fitch's Pumpkin Treasure Hunting event will be ended, Fitch's Stitched Pumpkin will no longer drop）

【Feather Emblem】can be used to exchange various items in Nia's shop, there's upper exchanging limit for each item

The event token【Feather Emblem】will not be deleted at the end of event, players can use it when event reopen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/40df6c7316910296d51f393b2dbb7ea276194f64.png[/img]
[b]【Feather Emblem】[/b]
*A feather full of holy aura, collected by Nia for you as a special token, but the lingering aura on it seems particularly familiar?
*With this emblem, you can exchange it with Nia for the private collection she prepared for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/c410802cff58725b396b8400ef77d768c33a33ea.png[/img]
*Equipment will be added to Academy Cup Shop after event ended.

Reward List:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/40ecaebd14496e9cc117775a57d6119bad0757b4.png[/img]

[h3]Academy Cup Challange[/h3]
[b]■Event Introduction[/b]
 Academy Cup is the tournament held regularly by the Blackguard Academy. Commanders can lead their teams to compete against other commanders' Black guards, get ranks according to their battle results and activeness, and win [Academy Coins]

[b]■Event Rules[/b]
The Academy Cup will be unlocked after passing Ch. 8 "Arctic Anchorage", click Arena and select Academy Cup to enter

Commanders have 3 free challenges everyday. After all free challenges get used, the continued challenges will consume the [Academy Cup Ticket]. The number of free challenges and ticket purchase chances will be refreshed at 00:00 everyday

In a challenge, 3 matches are played, and each match can use 4 different Black Guards with a time limit of 90 seconds. The side who defeated all blackguards of the other side within the time limit wins the match. If timeout, the [Defending Side] wins. The commander who wins 2 of the 3 matches is the final winner

The challenger will get points if wins, lose points if loss for the most of time. The amount of points is affected by the rank and the score differences between the two commanders. The Commander with more points earns more [Academy Coins], commanders must manually click to claim [Academy Coins]. [Academy Coins] can be used to exchange for awards in [Black Market]

Triple Challenge is available with the cost of 2 extra [Academy Cup Tickets]. If won, get triple points. When lose, the points decresed won't be tripled. Abnormal exit during the battle will be recorded as a lose, and the [Academy Cup Tickets] used will be deducted

[b]■The relationship between rank and score is as follows [/b]
Novice - 0 to 149 
Apprentice - 150 to 399 
Elite - 400 to 899 
Mentor - 900 to 1999
Master - 2000 to 3999
Grand Master - 4000 or above

[b]■Notes[/b]
Each season lasts two weeks. When each season ends, score and rank of Academy Cup for each player will be reset
If the [Principle Supervisor] of the guild ends as top 20 at the end of the season, [Principle Supervisor] and other guild members will be awarded  a large amount of Guild Coins. The higher the ranking is, the more Guild Coins will be awarded
Equipment will be added into the Academy Cup Shop for players to exchange in the future version

Commanders have 3 free challenges everyday. After all free challenges get used, the continued challenges will consume the [Academy Cup Ticket]. The number of free challenges and ticket purchase chances will be refreshed at 00:00 everyday

In a challenge, 3 matches are played, and each match can use 4 different Black Guards with a time limit of 90 seconds. The side who defeated all blackguards of the other side within the time limit wins the match. If timeout, the [Defending Side] wins. The commander who wins 2 of the 3 matches is the final winner

The challenger will get points if wins, lose points if loss for the most of time. The amount of points is affected by the rank and the score differences between the two commanders. The Commander with more points earns more [Academy Coins], commanders must manually click to claim [Academy Coins]. [Academy Coins] can be used to exchange for awards in [Black Market]

Triple Challenge is available with the cost of 2 extra [Academy Cup Tickets]. If won, get triple points. When lose, the points decresed won't be tripled. Abnormal exit during the battle will be recorded as a lose, and the [Academy Cup Tickets] used will be deducted

[b]■The relationship between rank and score is as follows [/b]
Novice - 0 to 149 
Apprentice - 150 to 399 
Elite - 400 to 899 
Mentor - 900 to 1999
Master - 2000 to 3999
Grand Master - 4000 or above

[b]■Notes[/b]
Each season lasts two weeks. When each season ends, score and rank of Academy Cup for each player will be reset
If the [Principle Supervisor] of the guild ends as top 20 at the end of the season, [Principle Supervisor] and other guild members will be awarded  a large amount of Guild Coins. The higher the ranking is, the more Guild Coins will be awarded

notes.title: [Book of Yog] Version Review of Dec. and Future Outlook
notes.content:
Hello Commanders, time runs so fast that I am not even aware it's been December. It was late night at weekend when I was writing this article, no one besides me, finally I can sit down by myself and write something quietly.

From November until now, we have had a lot of reliable and lovely new peers joined our team, and the technical team has doubled numbers now, which finally gives us hope in the struggling development progress.

First of all, I would like to apologize to all the players for the unpleasant experience caused by my personal negligence, but please trust me that we did not meant to do anything negative.

In the future, we will compensate players by providing more modification Stone benefits and resend  modification stone bundles (BF Box III, BF Box VI) to those who purchased them during Black Friday Sale, and increase modification stone benefits for little paid players. Please have an eye on our future announcement, and we promise that we will take extreme care about such adjustment before future update.

Then let's talk about the development plan in the following version:

[h3]Increase more player benefits, more equipment design, improve game balance, increase hero diversity, and expand main storyline[/h3]

1. Offer more free events and lots of benefits regularly

2. Continue to increase the profit of monthly card, super monthly card and lifetime card

3. Improving hero balance and farmation diversity

In the current version, we found out that most players currently have a fairly monotonous selection of heroes

The next step we will gradually increase the power of some S-tier heroes and enlarge their characteristics

At the same time, we will increase the speed and quantity of releasing exclusive equipment to enrich the exploration of game content

4. Optimize  the time-cost of modifying equipment

Considering the current modification system operation is too tedious, we plan to introduce advanced modifiucation functions to improve the convenience of modification. The player will simply need to set the goals, and modication will run automatically, drastically reducing the amount of actions needed.

5. New story: Due to the expansion of manpower, we are planing to expand the main story. The player will experience the advance of the storyline in the future, and we are also working on the design of the main character's career system and career transition system

However, there is too many content needed to be accumulated, it will take some time to construct and finally launch for players to experience, please be patient with us

6. Improve the level design quality and add more and more interesting level elements


[h3]December - Plan before the Spring Festival[/h3]

1. We will optimize the reset rule of Academy Gifts. For example, if all the rewards have been claimed after 10 days via reset, players can choose to manually reset and start a new round of Academy Gifts

2. Enhance some S-tier heroes' combat power. The first bunch of hero in the optimization plan list are: Crimson Scythe, Northland Princess, Mythic Instructor, Kingdom Huntress, Chief Raven 

3. Introduce some new functions: advanced modification command, one-click to use fragments, equipment plan saving

4. Add Heirloom modification feature: Heirlooms will also have affixes and can be modified

5. Introducing Equipment Rune system: It will be a brand new loot system and will randomly drop in certain levels. Runes are divided into primary runes and secondary runes. Each primary rune has a different effect when activated. Players need to place secondary runes properly into slots to activate more primary rune effects

6. Continue to optimize guild benefits and gameplay content to increase guild cohesion
	
7. Launch new Hero Challenge gameplay (Keep it secret for now)

8. Prepare the hero talent system and the new Mainland Stage system (these will be after the Lunar New Year, for now is just a blueprint)

===============

In the end, I want to say thanks to y'all for your continuously support at the Book of Yog. World Cup is ongoing, good luck to you and the team you supported.

I have been a Barca fan for over 20 years and have followed the club since Rivaldo; I Like Holland, more like Messi, early morning is the knockout series, hope Argentina good luck.

The maiden who calls herself the “God’s Scioness" seems to have existed since time immemorial. She has awakened from a long slumber, nothing is known of her origins and her actions.

For some unknown reason, Florentia and Sutherland were born in the same body, their soul and blood entangled with each other.

In the darkest nights, one can often see Florentia holding the "Book of Yog", her red eyes are faintly shining with a blood-like luster. A deep and sonorous rumble comes out of her mouth, dark and turbid, but listening carefully it seems to resemble some sort of a language.
