notes.title: Server Maintenance & Patch Notes of Nov. 17th
notes.content:
Dear Commanders:

The Book of Yog will have an update maintenance on 14:00, Nov. 17th. (UTC+8) The maintenance is expected to take 60 - 180 minutes.

The maintenance will be a mandatory update. After the maintenance, please update the client to the latest version before start the game.

During the maintenance, the players will be forcibly disconnected and unable to login. Please logout before the maintenance to avoid any data loss.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2]Patch Notes of Nov. 17th[/h2]

[h3]Event Duration[/h3]
ExtendedThe duration of the Fitch's Pumpkin Treasure Hunt has been extended until the update of the end of November.

[h3]New Equipment[/h3]
New drops of the Misty Mountains: Defense of Hunter, Blade of Guardian, Valiant of Support, Blessing of Striker

New Exclusive of Asura's Blade: Muramasa

New Exclusive of Fleur of the Heart: Fleur Coeur


[h3]Adjustments of Battle Content[/h3]
Damage reduction now has a maximum effective value of 98% in normal battle, and a maximum effective value of 99% in arena battle.

Now the crit damage reduction effect will not reduce the crit damage below the base crit multiplier (200%).



[h3]New Outfit[/h3]

Fleur of the Heart - Summer's Fleur

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/677ba8761d064caec6d841ac2e3d61ba86512a74.png[/img]

[h3]New Front System[/h3]
New 9 and 10 level front effects for: Guardian, Striker, Assassin, Mystic, Support, Hunter.
Adjusted parts of the old front effects of Guardian and Assassin front.
Increased the level cap of the front. The level cap of SS hero has been increased to 7, the S hero has been increased to 6. When the hero is upgraded to the corresponding level, you can choose one of the hero's exclusive front class to use.


New Exclusive Front Class
Rangers (4) Umbra (4) Avengers (4) Sages (4) Nullifiers (4) Invokers (6) Souleaters (4) Healers (6) Summoners (6) Spiritmasters (4) Vanguards (4) Fairies (4) Leaders (2)


*More details about the new front system, please pay attention to the patch notes of the follow-up announcement, the content of the front is subject to the official version.

[h3]Update on Guild[/h3]
New Guild Bounty System
To unlock the Guild Bounty system, the guild need to reaches the corresponding level. Completing the guild bounty task can increase the guild experience and can obtain some of Guild Coins. The guild randomly post 50 guild bounty tasks every day, and each player can complete a maximum of 10.

[h3]New Front Talent System[/h3]
Players can only upgrade the front talent system by joining a guild.
Front talents are divided into Main Talent (developed in this version) and Sub Talent (enabled at the end of November). The level cap of the Main Talent is the same as the current guild level cap, and the Sub Talent level cannot exceed the Main Talent level.
Each time you increase your talent level by 1, you will get 1 talent point of the corresponding talent system.
New Guild Battle Bosses: New added guild boss of 26~30 level.

[h3]New Levels[/h3]
New Chapter: Chapter 12.
Ra's Tower expended to 8001-9000 floors.
The Gate of Old Ones' 400/450 level has been adjusted to 425/500 level.
The Misty Mountains increased to 301-350 level.

[h3]New Favorability[/h3]
EventAsura's Katana: New Favorability story. New Favorability event of level 10, completing the event can obtain Asura's Katana's exclusive equipment.


[h3]New Index[/h3]
New equipment index is enabled.

Optimize the HP bar display rules to reduce the frequency and duration of unnecessary occurrences.
Fixed the problem that the abnormal battle data of the arena.
Strengthen Crystal now will be displayed in the currency column.
Optimized the arena battle report problem.
Fixed the problem that the heirlooms equipped on the characters placed in the Front position could not be replaced.
Fixed the problem that after quickly exiting the tower battle, the player cannot start the battle if the player starts the battle again too quickly.
Fixed an issue that the equipment effects of [Zen’s Gaze] and [Veil of Nox] would cause abnormal line effects.
Added the function that some interfaces can be quickly closed and exited by clicking ESC.
Fixed an issue that the initial front effect of the arena defender did not take effect.
Fixed the problem that after the number of echoes obtained during the exploration battle was reached the upper limit, it will display abnormal after re-entering the game.
Fixed the problem that the red dot prompt still exists after auto claim.
Fixed an issue that the blackstone drop level was displayed abnormally.
Fixed an issue that Barbara's ultimate skill would not work under special conditions.
Fixed an issue that the Tide Stalker equipment skill would not work.
The main city quick jump button adds favorability interface jump.
Optimized the problem that the hero interface becomes stuck when switching heroes.
Optimized the use of Whetstone, now it can also be used if it is less than 5 levels away from the level cap.
Fixed the invincible bug caused by special condition in arena battles.
Fixed the problem that the prompt red dot still exists after the event is completed.
The smithing interface now displays the level cap for affixes.

[S-Rank Striker Blackguard] Stormraven's Head - Ophelia

[b]Ultimate Skill: [Blade Flurry][/b] Ophelia stabs 5 times consecutively within 5 meters in front over 1 sec, each stab causes lightning damage equal to physical power, releases a fatal stab after 0.5 sec, causing damage equal to physical power, then knocks back the enemy and makes them electrocuted.
[b]Combat Skill: [Glowstep][/b] Charge 6 meters to the target direction, deal lightning damage equal to physical power to the enemies on the path, stun the enemy that in Electrocution state for 1 sec.
[b]Support Skill: [/b]
[b][Thunderous Justice] [/b]Last attack of Blade Flurry will reset the CD of Glowstep, and the next Glowstep's crit chance increased by {0}.
[b][Onslaught Will] [/b]When Glowstep hits the enemy in Electrocution state, Ophelia gain shield equal to {0} of physical power, the Max shield equal to {0} of physical power, shield last for 20 sec.
[b][Flash Assault] [/b]When Glowstep causes crit damage, the CD of Glowstep reduced by {0} sec, and damage dealt of Glowstep to enemy in Electrocution state increased by 50%.
[b][Peerless Blademaster] [/b]When Onslaught Will triggered, Ophelia gain 1 stack of Blademaster, each stack of Blademaster increases Ophelia's skill crit chance and crit damage by {0}. And every 7 points of physical mastery will increase skill crit chance and crit damage from each stack of Blademaster by 0.5%, stacking up to 5 times and last for 20 sec.

[h3]【14 Days Limited Time Sign-in Event】[/h3]

[b]■Event Details[/b]
During the qualification activation of the event, players who complete the chapter 1: area 3-2 [normal] can activate the 14-day limited-time sign-in qualification.
After activating the qualification, players can log to the game after 8:00 every day to sign-in at the event interface to get gifts.
[Qualification Activation Duration: From November 01 to November 14, 2022]
[Event Duration: From November 01 to December 6, 2022]

[b]■Event Notes[/b]
During the qualification activation period, if players who meet the activation conditions do not activate the event, they will not be able to participate in the event after the qualification activation expires.
For players who have activated the sign-in qualification, if the sign-in is not completed after the event ends, the event interface will close.

[b]■Sign-in Gifts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/09aed3d508086ec73d6a257cb83cc9383cd86553.png[/img]

[h3]【New Event of Ra's Tower - Lula Campaign】[/h3]
1. Ra's Tower will have 10 tower master positions for players to compete for (ranked from low to high).
2. The tower owner will get extra Lula every Monday (same arena time). If the tower owner is appointed as the [Sword Bearer] of the guild, he and his guild members can also get Guild Coins rewards every week.
3. Complete the specified number of floors in Ra's Tower can obtain the challenge qualification of the corresponding sequence of tower master. The higher the tower master sequence, the higher the completion number of floors required.
4. Players will occupy the sequence position immediately if he challenges the tower master success.

[h2]【Major adjustment】[/h2]
[h3]【Explore Chapter Structure adjustment and New Chapter Content】[/h3]
1. The structure of some exploration chapters has been adjusted, and most of the chapters have been merged. The original 26 chapters of exploration chapters will be adjusted to 9 chapters, and the total number of levels will remain unchanged.
2. New exploration chapter: Chapter 9, and chapter 9 will drop new gears: badges & pants.

[b]【Ancients of Echo Level Rules Adjustment】[/b]
1. For players whose Ancients level is > 400, their Ancients of Echo will be reset to level 400. All materials will be 100% returned by mail.
2. The upgrade of Ancients of Echo will no longer consume Lula.
3. The level of Ancients of Echo can increase the upper limit (each mythical/eternal hero increases the upper limit of the level by 10/25).

New talent system of the Ancients of Echo [Extremis]
Ancients of Echo will get extremis points each time when level up, which can be allocated in the [Extremis] interface to enhance abilities.

Optimization of the Ancients of Echo upgrade operation.

[h3]【Other Level Adjustments】[/h3]
1. The Misty Mountaions level has added 50 levels.
2. The number of floors in Ra's Tower has been increased to 6001 to 7000.
3. Four new exclusive equipment drops have been added to the Misty Level.
4. Two new heirlooms have been added to the Mist Shop.

[h3]【Front Line Adjustment】[/h3]
Now, when the Blackguard upgrades the front line, his own quality needs to be at least epic +.

[h3]【Blackstone Adjustment】[/h3]
Replaced all blackstones' icon styles

[h3]【Model Optimization】[/h3]
Iterated the model of the SS-rank hero - Frozen Heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/cca43609b24c591b40c643c89814b427e863e8d4.png[/img]

[h3][Bug fixes and other optimizations][/h3]
1. Fixed an issue that when equipping Lightning Master would cause damage to teammates.
2. [In order to avoid the presence of too many magic bullets at the same time and cause the lagging], the effect of the Magic Bullets set is adjusted as follows:
The skill damage of the Magic Bullets set is increased by 300%, and the fire interval of magic bullets is increased by 100%.
The magic bullet fired has been changed from group damage to single-target damage.
3. Fixed the problem that the effect of the gear [Finger of Yang Yan] could not take effect correctly.
4. Fix the problem that the gear [Redemption Angel] may cause the game to crash.
5. Verdant Ranger's passive skill [Ranger Training] has been changed to: increases 15% of dodge chance and 15% skill crit chance.
6. Asura's Blade's skill【Blessing of Kimono】has been changed to: When there are no enemies within 6 meters, Sakura will step through the shadow to flash behind the nearest enemy. The trigger chance of Shadowmeld increased by 10% and the duration increased.
7. Fixed the problem that the commander task could not be completed when the hero level met the commander task conditions.
8. Fixed an issue that the healing effect did not take effect on characters who were invincible.
9. Legendary Washing Stone and Immortal Washing Stone will still retain the existing attributes after use.
10. Now players can preview the loot drops from unlocked levels of the Misty Levels.
11. Now enter the equipment enhancement interface, the equipment that has not been enhanced to the full level will be selected by default.
12. Optimized the settlement display rules of the battle settlement.
13. Fixed the issue that when reset a hero, the heroes be obtained after reset would be regarded as a newly acquired hero and included in the Index.
14. Fixed the incorrect text description of equipment: [Wild Hunt] & [Crimson Lament].
15. Fixed the problem that the hero level-related tasks could not be completed after the Ancients of Echo breakthrough.
16. The arena tickets were renamed, and the purchase price was adjusted.
17. Fixed the problem that only one of the relics will be effective when multiple relics are equipped in the team.
18. Fixed an issue that the hero might not attack after teleporting.
19. Optimized the problem that all characters do not move during the idle.
20. Auto-battle function of The Misty Mountains is enabled

notes.title: Oct. 19th Update Contents Preview
notes.content:
Hi dear commanders, the following are the introduction of the contents of the Oct. 19th update.

[h3]Summoning Optimization[/h3]
New SS Blackguard Wishlist: When you pull an SS Blackguard, there is an 80% rate to obtain the SS Blackguard that you selected in the wishlist.
The wishlist resets at 8:00 a.m every day. After the selected SS Blackguard is obtained, you need to wait until the reset at 8:00 the next day before continuing to select.

[h3]Mall Contents Update[/h3]
New Scarlett outfit: [Romance on White Beach]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/dbfeb303f2afa0548c673ab2f38a290dd676ec95.png[/img]

New packages: New contents of daily and weekly gift packs, new limited-time gift packs.

[h3]Guild Optimization[/h3]
1. Now the guild will be disbanded immediately after the disbanding time is up.
2. The guild name change function is available now. The guild leader and vice-leader can change the guild name by consuming 1500 diamonds.
3. The guild interface has been iterated.

[h3]Ranking Board Optimization[/h3]
1. Optimized the ranking board interface.
2. New ranking board: Hard Level and Misty Mountains. The ranking board will display guild name now. 
3. Optimized the ranking logic. Now, under the same level and stage, the player who complete the battle with the shorter the time, the higher the ranking he will get.

[h3]Modification Optimization[/h3]
1. New reset function of gear enhancement. Now reset the enhanced gears, will return 100% of the consumed materials.
2. Optimized the auto enhancement function.
3. After selecting the mythical gear in the Blackguard interface, you can jump to the modification interface.

[h3]Combat Optimization and Skill Adjustment[/h3]
1. The effect of Asura's Katana skill [Heart of Killing] has been adjusted from (crit chance increased by 15%/crit damage increased by 50%) to (crit chance increased by 30%/crit damage increased by 75%)
2. General skills for assassian Blackguards: [Barrier] replaced with [Shadow Escape]
[Shadow Escape]: When taking damage, there is a 10% chance to trigger Shadow Escape, immune to the damage, and immune to all damage for the next 0.2 sec, trigger interval 10 sec.
3. Now the skill to dispel buffs can dispel all buffs directly, instead of only dispelling 1 buff.

[h3]Levels and Stages Adjustment[/h3]
1. Hard and Blacktide difficulty will drop Soul Crystal now.
2. The monsters on Misty Mountains will drop Soul Crystal now.
3. New ring and belt will drop in the Misty Mountains.
4. The number of floors of the Tower of Suncaller has been increased from 5001 to 6000.

[h3]Performance Optimization[/h3]
New Setting option: new Graphics Quality setting:
"Low": cancel the light projection effect, save performance.

New attribute: Max Rage. The initial max rage of the character is 1000, the max rage can be increased via equipment customization. The rage no longer be reset after release the ultimate skill, instead it consumes 1000 of rage now.

[b]Adjustment of formula of affixes [damage reduction][/b]
Through version experience and player feedback, we noticed that the current damage reduction attribute can reach a very exaggerated value, which makes current gameplay is too simple and single. notes.title: [Book of Yog] Version Review of Sept. and Future Outlook
notes.content:
Hello, Commanders, I'm Lao Wang, long time no see. Time has passed quickly, the high temperature in summer is finally over, and September is coming to an end before I had realized. Well, just intend to continue to share with you about this month's development feeling and future plans.

    Honestly, September was a bit of a contradiction for us. For us who have been in a state of high-intensity overtime, there are two holidays in the middle of September and the end of the month, which gives our team more time to relax. But it also means that there are fewer workdays available for development, and many of the ideas and plans on the to-do list are delayed, which makes us a little anxious.

    I would also like to thank everyone for giving us enough support, as well as the pertinent criticism and encouragement from all commanders, which has given us greater confidence in our own path. For game content, we know that bringing the fun of the game to everyone is our final and only goal, and we will continue to expand tasks, events, loot, new characters, and levels to make the game be more fulfilling and interesting.

    Right now, our team is working hard to fix a few remaining issues while thinking about how to add new content. As a young team lack of technical accumulation, we are also constantly developing new tools to improve the efficiency of development. The whole pace of the development of our game is in an accelerated process, it will become faster and more stable, so please stay tuned and give us more time.

Well, let's talk about the development plan in the following version:

[b]Increase player benefits, enrich the social interaction of the game, and develop new level and modes[/b]

[h2]1. New Chat System[/h2]
    We will refactor the chat system of the game to enhance the social experience of players with social needs, so that players can feel the activity of other players in the server.

[h2]2. Enrich the Gameplay of the Guild System[/h2]
    The Guild System is one of the contents that we take very seriously recently.
    I plan to enrich the benefits of the guild system, so that players can obtain a lot of resources in the guild, and at the same time it can help player improve the collection speed of characters greatly.
    We hope that players can become an active group and have their own role in the team, which can bring more benefits to themselves and their companions.

[h2]3. Enrich Battle Mode and Team Formation[/h2]
    We noticed that the current formation of heroes is a bit too monotonous, resulting in a simple and boring battle rhythm. We hope that players can have more available ideas and have more battle strategy options. 
    We have found the reason that caused this situation and are working to optimize it. We are confident that we can optimize it, but it will take about 1-3 months to improve it with gradual updates.

[h2]4. Optimize and Reduce the Cost of the Gear Modification[/h2]
    At present, it needs to be cost dearly to obtain some advanced modification stones in the game, which increases part of the burden during the play. We believe that the modification system should be a basic fun in the game. If the player can only cost dearly to experience this system, it will affect the enthusiasm of players to try the new gears, which is not conducive to the healthy development of the game ecology.
    Regarding modification stones, we will gradually optimize the relevant output and corresponding prices. With the increase in the number of items dropped, players can obtain modification items more conveniently and efficiently.

[h2]5. New Ranking, and New Gameplay Mode of the Level[/h2]
Such as:
    Challenge the exploration level with single commander: can only use commander to challenge the new exploration levels.
    Blackguard Class Tower: challenge the new level of the Tower of Suncaller, commander can only use a specific class of Blackguard to challenge the new levels of the tower.

[h2]6. Development Plan from September to October[/h2]

1. Academy Gifts will greatly enhance the benefits and shorten the reset time.

2. We are considering adding a new level of hero awakening. Awakening will activate a new hero skill, but we do not have time and energy to design the new skills of all heroes at the same time, so the new hero awakening will be enabled in batches.

3. Strengthen the abilities of some S-rank heroes, improve and strengthen assassin and guardian heroes, including modifying the effect of the Front System, adding exclusive gear, etc.

4. Continue to optimize the battle system to enrich the battle rhythm and hero training mode.

5. Optimize the information available for the modification system, reduce the difficulty of getting started with the modification system, and add new functions. For example, players can preview the affix that may be randomly obtained during modification, etc.

6. Continue to extend the number of the levels of the Misty Mountains and the Tower of Suncaller, add more designs of the heirloom, improve heirloom attributes, and reduce the difficulty of the Misty Mountains in the early stage, so that more players can experience this gameplay.

7. Continue to work on the optimization of game performance.

    Thank you for reading to the end, here is a small gift to thank you for your support!
[h3]
    [LAOWANG001] DiamondsX1000, Invalid Time: 30th Sept.[/h3]

notes.title: September 1st Update Content Preview
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of Book of Yog, and the following will introduce the contents of the update of September 1st.

[b][h3]1. New Gameplay: Misty Mountains [/h3][/b]
After entering the Mist Mountains, players can accumulate Mist progress by killing monsters in battle. When the progress is full, players can choose to consume AP to challenge Mist Boss, and obtain loots after defeating the Boss.
If the player defeats the boss within 5 minutes after the start of the challenge, it will be regarded as the completion of the challenge, and the next level will be unlocked. If the time limit is exceeded, you can still choose to challenge the Boss. After winning, you can obtain loots, but can not unlock the next level.
If you successfully challenge within the time limit, you can get "Mist Crystal", which can be exchanged for Mythical Gear in the store in the future.
 
[b][h3]2. New System: Heirloom[/h3][/b]
Heirloom has rare skills, and the skill effects can be boosted by consuming Mist Coins. Boosting to a certain level will unlock new skill effects.
Heirloom will not be obtained repeatedly, and each hero can carry 1 type of Heirloom.
After the version update, 4 types of Heirlooms will be unlocked, and more types of new Heirlooms will be unlocked in the future.

notes.title: [Book of Yog] August Version Review
notes.content:
Hi guys, I'm Lao Wang.

    The version in mid-August is finally online, and I can finally spare some time to chat with you about these days and the future.

    In terms of development process, this version update is torturous. We set aside more time than usual, but there were still many, many serious problems that caused the team to work overtime until the early hours of the morning, and everyone was exhausted physically and mentally.

    We have done a review: the team has shortcomings in testing capabilities, so we have not been able to find and solve many problems in time. In the future, we need to improve our capabilities to solve these problems.

    We have a lot of development content on our to do list, and frankly we are very confident about the future game content. However, due to the experience and the size of the team, the actual development time left for each version is less than 10 working days. I can only make limited arrangements to take care of the players and the partners in the team.

    There is a girl in our technical team. She commutes to and from work for more than 3 hours every day. I don’t want the whole team to work until late at night, which will also break us from the inside.

    I hope that players can understand us a little while waiting anxiously for the game content. Our team is young, we make mistakes and sometimes we don't think well, but we try to be the best we can.

    We are also looking for more capable partners to solve the technical problems of the team and make the player's game experience smoother. At the same time, our goal has always been to make games easier and more fun.

    Next, let's talk about the future plan:

Increase the benefits of the game
1. We will increase the stability of obtaining heroes from the summoning. After reaching a certain number of pulls, you will be able to obtain the "Blackguard Roster".
2. We will increase the drop of hero fragments in the loots. As the level progresses, players can get more and more hero fragments from the loots, including SS heroes.
3. New activity gameplay that everyone can participate and can obtain more rewards.
4. We are considering to further enhance the rewards of the monthly card.

Content development direction
1. Great Rift gameplay
For the version at the end of August, we plan to launch the "Great Rift" gameplay. Players can experience new gameplay, challenge new levels and collect legendary runes. However, due to the tight development cycle, we expect it to be only an initial version when it is released. Hope players can understand us. In the future, we will improve the gameplay and add more and more legendary runes.

2. Increase the content of the main storyline in the level
This is a very important part of our original plan, and we will gradually add the storyline in the game. For the plot content, whether it is development, or how to design and present it in the game, it is not a easy work, so we will gradually add some ​​contents.
Players can gradually understand more stories of Commander, Blackguard and Arkrance during the game, gain talent skill points (another new system), and challenge the enemy.

3. Commander talent system
The talent skill tree is a system we have planned for a long time, and we have always been eager to try such a fun system.
In our plan, when the commander upgrades the soul level, talent points can be obtained, and the reasonable allocation of talent points will make your commander more powerful and more distinctive.
The commander's class transfer and class talent system will also be opened in the future.

There are still many things I want to talk to you about, but there are still many things to be busy with, let's see you next time!

Thank you all for your love and support of Book of Yog!

notes.title: About the English language version plan
notes.content:
Hello Commanders,

Due to lack of manpower and lack of experience, in the previous English version, we only carried out machine translation of important parts. Therefore, for a long time, the English version has problems such as missing text translation, machine translation errors, inconsistent terms, etc., which have caused a terrible game experience. We are deeply sorry for this.

At present, the staff who in charge of translation, is not only in charge of the optimization of the English version but also in charge of other work contents. Therefore, it's hard to perfect this part of the translation work quickly. For the current existing translation problems, we can only deal with different parts gradually. Step by step, such like hero details to skills to items, etc.. Therefore, the perfect optimization of the English version will be a long-term project, but our work has already started, and we guarantee that the translation-optimized contents will be perfected asap.

Before the last data deletion test on July 16 launched, in order to ensure that players in English-speaking regions can experience the game smoothly, we have temporarily machine-translated all texts in the game (some new contents may be missed). The text of some important systems has been refined to ensure that the main game experience will not be greatly affected.

In the future, we will refine the text of the game according to the following plans:

1. Gradually proofread and fine-tune all text content to reduce errors.
2. Unify proper nouns (heroes, skills, equipment, etc.) to facilitate players to communicate.
3. Process the text content as soon as the content is updated.

Because of our limited manpower, this work will be a relatively long-term project for us, but we promise that we will start the text translation as soon as possible, and hope that commanders will remain patient and confident in us! Thanks for your understanding and support!

notes.title: [Designer Talk] When designing The Verdant Ranger, what were we thinking?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/0c7794564e32d5cd95d7b7667693095801de4735.png[/img]

[h2]A small backpack, a big mystery![/h2]

[b]Author | Zhou, Xiaoyun[/b]

[u]Hey guys! Our third test will be launched within two weeks! In order to let our players get familiar with our game, we will share more contents with you![/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/17cb26d1ba0eb6005a8fdc638c3740a3bc92c610.png[/img]

[b]Curious Scholar - Noli[/b]
Gender: Female
Race: Elf
Birthday: February 14
Birthplace: Camble League-Alchemy City Nelas
Height and weight: 139cm/31kg
Specialty: Speed reading, arithmetic, alchemy
Favorite things: new knowledge, touched heads, rare research materials, free research
Disgusting things: old antique! Stingy person!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/ecd74c25e4fa638cbb840074cddc375d251db998.png[/img]

Perhaps attentive players will find that this little girl with a big backpack on her back is almost as tall as herself, and has appeared many times in our recent sharing. In the recently completed scene -  workshop, Noli will also appear here. Taking this opportunity, today the designer Xiaoyun specifically asked the designer Zhou several questions about designing ideas to Noli——

[b]Q1: When portraying the character of Noli, did you focus on certain points?[/b]
A2: Noli is not easy to portray, because most people nowadays don't like naughty kids and find they are very annoying. So the key point in portraying Noli is to grasp the scale of "naughty". It is necessary to show a girl who is lively, energetic, and always planning to do some prank, but not to overdo it. To give her a reliable and pleasing side, and to give her a reason for being naughty. It is not for the sake of being naughty, but out of the alchemist’s thirst for knowledge, and that's why there will always be accidents in the process of exploring new things, etc. .

[b]Q2: Noli's image is very cute. Will this give you any inspiration in the design process?[/b]
A2: To be precise, there was Noli's character design first, and then the character image. However, the image of the character drawn by the art design is almost the same as I imagined in my heart. The small body is carrying a large backpack, full of props that will be used for experiment (prank), especially the frog on the head is very funny, it shows an appearance that survived the Big Bang in the laboratory.

[b]Q3: If you use three words to describe Noli, which three will it be?[/b]
A3: Lively, naughty, and smart.

[b]Q4: In the future, what role will Noli play in the plot?[/b]
A4: Noli is the best alchemist in the Black Guards Academy. Although she always explodes the laboratory, she has discovered many important items in the future through failure after failure. In the plot, she will be the backing of the Black Guards, using her alchemy technology to discover secrets that are hard for ordinary people to detect, and of course she will become one of the villains most hated and most want to get rid of.

[b]Q5: What is the marker of Noli?[/b]
A5: Noli’s marker is her big backpack, which is filled with snacks, alchemy props, and pots of potions. Don’t think of her as a little girl who can only rely on others for protection. You will never know that the things that she took out of her bag was a lollipop...or a potent potion that could explode a cloud of mushrooms.

[b]Q6: The alchemist seems to be a mysterious and unsmiling character in Western fantasy works. Is it to create a contrast effect for a "Naught kid" like Noli to become such a character?[/b]
A6: Yes, the image of the knowledgeable, tall, thin, and unsmiling alchemist is too common. It is difficult to make any new tricks in that image, so I just took another contrast and created a new one. The appearance is a kid, but the knowledge is more profound than anyone else's, this will appear more interesting.

[b]Q7: Have you ever wondered what Noli will look like when she grows up, and who is she more like in the current haracters?[/b]
A7: Noli will be a person who always has a childlike innocence, always keeps the thirst for knowledge and exploration. When she grows up, she may be more mature in appearance and figure, but the simple and innocent heart will not change, as always, lively and energetic, maybe will become the girlish version of Brahindo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/a1e3929a2c7fd896980688f3f04873869d044997.png[/img]

The above is the creation and sharing of the background story about Noli. In the actual game, Noli will appear in the player's team as a Mage Black Guard. If you want to see more thoughts on the creation of the background story of Black Guards, please look forward to sharing it next time~

Thank you for following our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/17cb26d1ba0eb6005a8fdc638c3740a3bc92c610.png[/img]

notes.title: [Designer Talk] When designing Pleasure Demoness, what were we thinking?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/0c7794564e32d5cd95d7b7667693095801de4735.png[/img]

Hi everyone, I'm Xiaoyun. During this period of time, I worked with the art staff to remake Pleasure Demoness. Thanks to the wonderful brushwork of art stuff, I have a lot of inspiration to rewrite her character background story.

[b][h2]【Design】[/h2][/b]
If I were to use a specific image symbol to summarize Réveille, I think it should be flame.

A cluster of small flames is often bright and warm, it is synonymous with warmth and hope; And the raging flames will remind people of the scenes of raging fires or raging wars, and most of the time, it is always with a sense of destruction. Therefore, the small flames and the raging flames have formed a kind of opposition, so how can this opposition be reflected in the background story of Réveille?

The Epithet of Réveille is "Pleasure Demoness." Whether from the first version to the current version, the art designing of Réveille insists on using red and black as the main colors, and the parts of the body have certain inhuman characteristics. So I extracted "pleasure", "inhuman", "red and black" as keywords, and diverged my thoughts based on these keywords.

The first is "pleasure", the opposite of pleasure is pain;
The second is "inhuman", and the opposite of "inhuman" is "human";
The last is “red and black”, which reminds me of a quote from Julien, the protagonist in the masterpiece "Le Rouge et le Noir (Red and Black)" by Stendhal: I may be humble, but I am not base.

When this sentence echoed in my heart, the raging flames seems full of fighting spirit, which reminded me of the image of "Phoenix". But when it is connected with the destruction meaning also represented by raging flames, it has an extreme opposition, which is Nirvana.

In summary, the basic idea of Réveille's background story has a rough outline: the "inhuman" or "pleasure" won’t exist with no reason. Before Réveille became a black guard, she had lived as an ordinary girl with a pain past, until Nirvana in a fire that could change her destiny...

Combined with the content of the current world view, a brief summary of her past should be:

Ordinary girl - the experiment of the Tower of Babel - the Awakener grey blood - Black Guard.
In line with the conventional way of writing "to gain the superpower, the poor rely on mutation, the rich rely on technology", Réveille's past kicked off in the experiment prison of Tower of Babel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/82dc2e3e09fc67dc8b90ef9d7b7c24261050c5b0.png[/img]

[b][h2]【Past】[/h2][/b]
For Réveille, her memory begins in the dark experiment prison of the Tower of Babel.

At first, there were no less than 30 girls about her age caged in that huge cell. All their memories were washed away, like a blank sheet of paper. The girls ate and lived here, received harsh training, and were subjected to various inhuman tortures by the jailers.

Girls with excellent training results will be taken out of prison by the jailer and never come back after that.

Those girls with poor training results were either killed by other girls in this cruel competitive fight, or were abused by the jailer again after being treated.

Réveille lives secretly in this hell. Until one day, when there were only six people left in the prison, she won the competition with another girl and got the opportunity to leave here.

The two girls who were taken out of the prison thought they could be free, but they never expected to be taken to a deeper and darker underground, where they were forcibly poured "grey blood."

This is the unfortunate but luckiest day of Réveille's life. When another girl was eroded and demonized by the grey blood, she awakened a powerful force from the grey blood.

It's hard to say that Réveille after awakening is still a human. Her hair became frosty, her eyes were red, and she even grew fierce claws. After killing the demonized girl who got out of control, she killed all the jailers in the fire of revenge, burned the prison to all, and vowed to kill all the members of the Tower of Babel.

A few months later, Réveille, who was constantly hunting down the members of the Tower of Babel, met the black guards. The black guards were surprised that the girl was awakened through the grey blood. Réveille also learned that the black guards had a common enemy with her.

The black guards took Réveille back to St.Nigal. And she stayed in a secret room for a day and night, she had a long conversation with the archbishop that no one knew the details.

Then, everyone suddenly discovered that Réveille's name appeared on the Black Guards roster...

The rest of her life was the time of living with the black guards in the Black Guards Academy, slaying enemies with them over the great wall, and it was also the time when her "pleasure" had just begun. The daily life of the college seems to be quietly awakening her sporadic good memories.

[h2][b]【Story ①】[/b][/h2]

No one knows where Réveille's hometown is, not even she herself. Only those images of the warmth leaping fire in the stove that often reverberate in her mind, and the sweet smell of pumpkin pie that seems to be still filling the tip of her nose, remind her of the past. Perhaps a long time ago, she also had a family as ordinary and happy as most people, and carefree childhood years.

Although Réveille often has doubts and thinks about the authenticity of these memory fragments, her expression will always betray her-every time she thinks of these memories, her smile will involuntarily bloom from her face, even the flames in her palms seems to be softer.

The leisurely and happy daily life reveals a touch of tenderness in her vague memories of the past years, making her could baked a sweet pumpkin pie; sleeping soundly under the cherry tree with fireflies; competing with cats for a warm stove; getting acquainted with friends who also use fire; and fighting alongside the black guards from time to time... It can be said that the real "pleasure" belonging to the Pleasure Demoness has just begun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/99faf4bff53c0674c42a6d2e94ad2c2000b87362.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your interest in Réveille, and reading this.

In the actual game, Réveille will appear in the game as a Sniper hero. If you want to see more thoughts on the creation of the background story of Black Guard, please look forward to the Designer Talk next time~

Thank you for your interest in our game!

notes.title: [Designer Talk] When designing this character, what were we thinking? (②)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I’m Xiaoyun~Continue to share some of my thoughts in the character design process~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/989de13a70a7424fa8cd32dc8cdc90d726ca5d08.png[/img]

[h2]【New Background Story】[/h2]

[h3][b]Story 3[/b][/h3]

[b]D[/b]uring Aliéno's childhood, there was a gardener in the family, and Aliéno had a very good relationship with her. The two often spend long afternoons together in the greenhouse of the earl’s mansion. Those days are full of splendid adventure stories, Aliéno also learned about the existence of the "Black Guards" from the story told by the gardener sister, and looked forward to and admired them.

One afternoon when Aliéno was ten, she came to the greenhouse and wanted the gardener to tell her a story, but the gardener was not there. After waiting for a while, she wandered aimlessly around the mansion. At this moment, she suddenly found that the antique clock in the hall seemed to be abnormal, so she leaned forward and observed it carefully and found a secret tunnel hidden behind the clock. She was impatient and curious, so she walked in.

After Aliéno walked in the secret tunnel for a long time, she found a strange wild rose on a hidden secret door. Aliéno leaned in the door to listen, but nothing happened. When she wanted to leave with a sense of bored, she inadvertently noticed the gardener sister stood at the fork in the secret tunnel. She couldn't help and called out, "sister!", but the gardener fled to the depths of the tunnel with a look of terrified.

At this moment, the secret door with wild roses suddenly opened. Several crossbowmen sprang from the door and fired in the direction of the gardener. After the shooting stopped, Aliéno's father walked out the door slowly, showing a triumphant smile. Aliéno was taken aback and hurried to the direction where the gardener was, only to find that the gardner had already been stuck a few arrows in the body. Aliéno was about to ask, but was controlled by the gardener with a sharp dagger. She takes Aliéno as a hostage and threatens the earl to let her leave.

[h3][b]Story 4[/b][/h3]
[b]
A[/b]liéno could feel the gardener sister behind her trembling constantly. Aliéno was worried about the gardener's injury, but she did not dare to act rashly. She didn't even know why her father ordered the attack on the gardener sister. The gardener held Aliéno and walked out of the secret tunnel. Finally, after leaving the mansion and entering a dense forest, the gardener sister behind her finally got exhausted and fell down.

Aliéno has never encountered such a situation. She wanted to check the injury for the gardener, only to find that the wound on the gardener's body had already burst, and the blood was flowing. Aliéno kept crying, her trembling hands trying to cover the blood flowing out of the gardener's body, but it didn't help.

In this uninhabited, dense jungle, how can there be someone to give a hand? Aliéno burst into tears.
Looking at the little girl who was being held hostage by herself, but crying helplessly because she couldn't save her life, the gardener shook her head helplessly and pleased. She was holding on her last breath and intermittently explained her true identity and purpose to Aliéno.

The gardener is a bounty hunter, and she sneaked into the earl's mansion to search for evidence of the earl's secret trade. She comforted Aliéno, she didn't have to feel sorry for herself. On the contrary, the gardener felt sorry for letting the young Aliéno witness bloodshed and death. In the last moment of the gardener's life, she recalled her years of fighting side by side with the Black Guards in a very nostalgic tone, and quietly closed her eyes.

After a day and a night, the soldier sent by the earl only found the unconscious Aliéno deep in the forest...

[h3][b]Story 5[/b][/h3]

[b]A[/b]fter Aliéno returned to the mansion, her relationship with the earl fell to a freezing point because the earl refused to communicate about the kidnapping incident. A servant recalled that the earl and Miss Aliéno had a fierce quarrel. After that, she moved away from the room very close to the earl's bedroom, insisted on living in a remote small room next to the mansion's greenhouse, and declined any visits.

Since everyone in the earl’s mansion knew that Miss Aliéno had been kidnapped by a gardener spy before, the servants took good care of her and did not dare to make any mistakes. But Aliéno didn't have any pretensions in front of the servants, and she didn't see anything unusual. As an earl's daughter, her courses remained the same every day, but besides that, she took the initiative to add gardening courses and medical research courses for herself.

Since then, she has been more openly not to participate in any social occasions such as tea parties, banquets, and dance parties. Moreover, the earl's mansion never hired any gardener after the kidnapping. Until many years later, Aliéno left a wild rose and a letter, and went to the distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/74d7581271b0da13ef904e9735d522219e304de0.png[/img]

[h2]【Background Design Ideas】[/h2]

In the process of rewriting the background story, I kept the background setting of Aliéno as an aristocratic daughter. Because just like every girl who grew up in a deep boudoir, Aliéno at the beginning was a protected "deep court rose." In the deep courtyard, the acquaintance with the gardener sister in the family, accompanied by her, has become the best memory of Aliéno's childhood. The adventure story of the gardener sister not only made her yearn for freedom outside the mansion more, but also made her aware of the existence of the "Black Guard".

That's because Alieno experienced the despair of being unable to do anything about life passing before her eyes, that made her persistently take the rescue of life as her own mission in her entire life. As the saying goes: "Unfortunate people use life to heal childhood, lucky people use childhood to heal life." She is unfortunate, but also lucky. Whether it is gardening or planting, or treating every injured black guard, it is a manifestation of Aliéno's self-salvation after her miserable experience.

Quietness and exaggeration, softness and spikes, life and death, these binary oppositions, together form Aliéno's past. Perhaps, she has met my expectations. As a character, she gets rid of the rigid judgment standard and truly has her own character arc, which is three-dimensional and flesh-and-blood.

Well, that's all sharing of Aliéno's story. For more background story design ideas of more Black Guard, please look forward to next time~

Thank you for follow our game!

Now, the top hunter secretly cultivated by the king, with an extremely clean background, successfully entered St.Nigal and approached her goal-Princess Flo.

Mioni's family lost their habitat during the Black Tide more than 100 years ago and has been wandering for years. Due to their appearance is too suited to the human aesthetic, many young half-beast human of the race set foot in the human world and want to settle down and develop in human towns, while only a few half-beast human still settle down in each forest.

Because of her childhood influence, Mioni was inclined to return to the free and secure life of 100 years ago. So she joined the Pioneer Blade in spite of opposition, only hoping to stand on the land once again.

[h3][b]【Skills 】[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/52b64795fbe756a157c7d400d5d88197bcc560a6.jpg[/img]

[b]Storm Shooting[/b]
Mioni shoots 8 arrows like a storm(the number of arrows is based on physical mastery), each arrow dealing [u]87.5%[/u] physical damage.

[b]Penetrating Arrow[/b]
Mioni shoots a penetrating arrow, dealing [u]27.6%[/u] physical damage to the target and the enemies behind it. Has a chance to place a crit buff to Mioni when the arrow hit the target, the buff limit is 10. Crit buff: each buff increase 3% skill crit rate and 5% crit damage.

[b]Weakness Aim[/b]
Mioni's accurate shooting skill increases her skill critical rate by [u]30%[/u].

[b]Deterrent[/b]
The penetrating arrow deals a [u]4 strength[/u] knockback to enemy targets when crit.

[b]Multiple Penetrating Arrow[/b]
The penetrating arrow changes to: shooting 3 arrows to enemies in a cone in front of Mioni, and the physical strength of the arrows increased by [u]5.1%[/u].

[b]Sniper's Concentration[/b]
If Mioni does not take damage for 3 seconds, increasing her skill crit rate ([u]6.8%[/u]+physical strength * 1).

[b]Deadly Aim[/b]
Damage to targets with less than [u]15%[/u] health can not be dodged.

[b]Enhance Constitution[/b]
Max HP increased by [u]300[/u].

[b]Rapid Fire[/b]
Attack speed increased by [u]22.5%[/u].

[b]Trueshot[/b]
Physical strength increased by [u]5%[/u].

[h3][b]【Gears Introduction】[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/a30cad32de13a61ca618e9105036714d00e74ea5.png[/img]

[b][Gears of crit and leeching][/b]

[b]Fearless[/b]: When there are no friendly units within 3 meters of you, crit rate increases by 10-20% and  dodge rateincreases by 15%.

[b]Scarlet Hunter[/b]: Give yourself a leeching buff every 10 seconds for 5 seconds.

[b]Vampiric Embrace[/b]: While leeching on itself, the leeching effect restores HP based on 3% - 6% physical strength and 3% - 6% spell strength to all friendly units. (20 hits per battle)

[b][Weapons][/b]

[b]Crash and Crash![/b]: Crit rate increased by 5% - 10%, if the character is a warrior the effect is increased by 3 times.

[b]Wild Hunt[/b]: Attacks have a 10-20% chance to go berserk. All normal attacks must hit, and must be critical for 5 seconds. Damage to bleeding targets increased by 50%.

[b]Blood Thirst[/b]: When active attacks deal damage to the targets, they have a 10-20% chance to bleed for 10 seconds. When dealing damage to a bleeding unit, 15% of the damage is converted to healing.

notes.title: 【Dev Log⑨】Summary of second testing(preface)
notes.content:
Hi guys, I’m Wang. It’s been a while since the second testing ended. Just finished arranging the team plans, it’s time to began to write some words to make some summary.

[h2]【Testing summary meeting】[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/87b4ed01f3d917d18717145a3bd56165e3e65e60.jpg[/img]

In fact, I often felt depressed during this period, especially during the testing period. Various problems in the game made me anxious and frustrated (So sorry again for the overseas players who can't play the testing demo). The gameplay wasn't perfect yet, and there were a ton of new features that needed to be developed. Being hit by such a flood of questions, it just suddenly throws you into a state of powerlessness.

However, I would like to thank the players for their sincere comments. There are a lot of good comments about "idle", "casual", "art content" and "build system", which let me restore some confidence.

We will continue to do better where we are outstanding, design more interesting gears, arrange more rich and exciting levels and gameplay, and design more cute and sexy characters with distinct personalities. Of course, we will keep the pace of the game light but fun, and then we will continue to tell the story of Saint Nigal.

The third test is expected in early November. Over the next two months, the team will focus on game performance tuning, game rule optimization, and numerical balancing, while we plan to add 3-4 new heroes, 50 + pieces of gears, a new storyline, a gem system, and diamond bonuses for days from 2-7. For more details and content, please look forward to future dev logs updates!

Hi, it's been a while since the second testing was over, and a lot of players are still asking us when the next testing will start. Don't be hurry~ The third test will start between the end of October and November.

While we wait for the next testing, I will continue to give you an overview of the game. Today, what we bring is the skill introduction of the first waifu of the players, Souls Reaper - Scarlett.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/b0c9eea31515bb40caf0c0169cb5eae022c441d1.png[/img]

[h2]Souls Reaper- Scarlett[/h2]

In the beginning of the game, Scarlett will join the player as the story progresses. As an S-class assassinate hero, she has a mysterious and agile combat style, and will win the battle for you with a deadly attack! No matter how powerful the enemy is, it will be instantly killed by her huge sickle. It should be noted, however, that as an assassination hero, Scarlett is also vulnerable to death. So in combat, the player also needs to match her skills and combinations according to her characteristics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/df12d9b909cced287ca6cddbff8b2a931896c113.png[/img]

[h2]Skill Introduction[/h2]

The underlined value represents the number will be changed with skill level changed.

[b]Ultimate Skill: Blade Strike[/b]
Scarlett blinks behind the enemy target farthest from her on the field, and swells her scythe to deal [u]588%[/u] frost damage based on spell power to the current enemy target, and freezes the target for 3 seconds.

[b]Combat skill: Cold Harvest[/b]
Scarlett blinks behind random enemy targets within 10 meters, and swells her scythe to deal [u]75.6%[/u] frost damage based on spell power.

[b]Combat skill: Phantom of Death[/b]
Scarlett blinks behind the enemy with the lowest HP when she is under 20% HP. Scarlett is invincible for [u]1.5 seconds[/u] and loss threat.

[b]Support Skill: Shadow Asylum[/b]
Scarlett takes [u]10% [/u]less damage after each blink for 5 seconds.

[b]Support Skill: Blade Sharpening[/b]
Scarlett's initial power increase [u]300[/u].

[b]Support Skill: Speedy Blade[/b]
Scarlett's skills' cool down decrease [u]10%[/u].

[b]Support Skill: Swashbuckler[/b]
Damage done to enemies whose spell power is lower than Scarlett increases by [u]9%[/u].

[b]Support Skill: Deadly Ambush[/b]
Damage done to enemies who have full HP increases by [u]11%[/u].

[b]Support Skill: Cloak of Shadows[/b]
The duration of the debuffed effect is reduced by [u]25%[/u].

[b]Support Skill: Barrier[/b]
When health is lower than 75/45/15%, trigger barrier status, reducing damage taken by 30% for [u]2 seconds[/u].

notes.title: 【Dev log⑧】An essay on the pace of development
notes.content:
Hi I’m Wang. I get asked all the time: "Make a free game on STEAM. Will players take it? " In my opinion, In fact, I think that for the player, having enough content is what you want as a player, not an absolute freemium or buy-out game.

I prefer to use the term "hybrid" to describe the Book of Yog. The hybrid game that I understand, It should have the advantages of free games with no economic barriers of interactivity and strong and continuous update ability, but also have the rich and coherent game content of single-play games, such as story, exploration, experience rhythm, etc.

I divided The Book of Cover into three development stages: [b]Battle & Cards, interactive upgrades, and Enhance Content.[/b]

[h2]Battle & Cards[/h2]

1:Have a certain number of levels to play, rich build content, rich growth system;

2:Have 20-30 characters to collect and cultivate;

3:Early game plot (the team size is still too small, the production capacity is insufficient, and the development tool is not mature enough, which is currently being addressed).

At this stage, the game is basically playable, but the experience is not rich enough. It is just a normal hard-core idle game, and it will be in this stage when the game is initially launched. (For those players who have a strong need for the game plot I want to say sorry first. Please give us some more time and patience, we are trying our best to improve the editor, please wait for us to perfect the tool!)

[h2]Interactive Upgrades[/h2]

1. Steadily add new levels, gears, skills, gems, storyline, and new skill mechanisms to enrich and deepen build system;

2. Steadily add new characters, averaging 1-2 characters per month;

3. Add activity gameplay, enrich the clan system, and provide gameplay of character collection and gear collection centering on activities;

4. Steady updates of plot content.

At this stage, the content of the game is relatively rich, with more interactive gameplay, and more research space for the build. The requirements for the player to play the game or pass the level are not identical, which allowing the player to play more freely.

At the end of this stage, when our tool chain is mature and the update of level content is stable, we will be fully engaged in the development of plot content and exploration system.

[h2]Enhance Content[/h2]

1.We will create over 20 separate scenes to shape the main city - St.Nigar - in the game. Players can explore the city in a variety of ways, such as investigating side quests, playing mini-games, training, and interacting with characters who play roles as students;

2:Players will play as a mercenaries commander, arrange the tour of the academy, accompany students, guide training, complete missions and deepen relationships with students in limited time, and promote the development of the story;

3:Increase the bond system, improve the ability of partners, activate the side-line story, learn about the character backstory, open exclusive weapon missions, etc.

At this stage, we will devote all our energies to creating a sophisticated and informative world of  St. Nigar.

Only every month, every aspect of the game is updated steadily, including rewards, levels, new characters, gear, story, activities, then I think this game is a qualified game, which the players will be willing to play such a game. I expect the whole development cycle to take about 8-12 months, so it's going to be a long, hard job for us.

However, I believe that as long as perseverance, our sincerity will attract our players!

The test is basically scheduled for August 25, and I sincerely welcome you to come and play our current game, and also welcome you to give us all kinds of criticism and suggestions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/e75a302f5694815c65496fa1b12f4acec059238c.png[/img]

notes.title: 【Walkthrough】The Equipment Workshop
notes.content:
Hi everyone, to get our players familiar with the game earlier. Today, let me introduce the equipment workshop system, which is closely related to the Equipment Build System.

As one of the most core and interesting system in Book of Yog, the Equipment Build System largely determines the direction of the game. By matching heroes with the powerful equipment which are randomly generated, players can create a unique team to experience a unique gameplay.

For example, by equipping the ranged heroes with the equipment which has “leeching” and “healing the team when leeching” skills, you can turn the ranged heroes into a composite class that deals damage as well as heals.

The equipment has five qualities in the game, divided into "Common", "Fine", "Rare", "Epic" and "Legend". Each equipment has three categories of attributes: two fixed generated attributes  “Main Attributes” and  “Equipment skill”, and one randomly generated attributes which is divided into “major affixes” and “minor affixes”. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/a4c82f0ec43094c9f991e3a0019ea7ab2a8c41ad.png[/img]

When the player gets an equipment, the “Main Attributes” and “Equipment Skill” are mixed, so the “major" affixes and “minor affixes” which are randomly generated. If you unsatisfied with some affixes, then the workshop is you first choose.

Next, let me introduce the different functions of the workshop.

[h1]Disenchantment and Enchantment[/h1]

During the game, you will definitely get a lot of equipment that you don't need. So what to do with all this equipment? The disenchantment function of the workshop is the first choice. The disenchantment function allows players to disenchant equipment they don't need in their packs. Depending on the quality of the equipment being disenchanted, different materials will be obtained, and these materials are essential for equipment enchanting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/5f41fd5f36a1f4e389666dd7088fb3bf81bfb028.png[/img]

The enchantment function is used to improve the main attributes of equipment. The maximum level of equipment in the game can be upgraded to 30 through the enchantment function, and the amount and type of materials required for every 10 levels are different, so there is a lot of "useless" equipment need to be disenchanted. Therefore, in a sense, there is no such thing as "useless" equipment in the game. 

Please note that the disenchantment process is irreversible, so you have to be careful when you do it.

[h1]Equipment Modification[/h1]

Then let's look at the major and minor affixes of equipment.

In the workshop, the function linked with the major affixes and minor affixes is the modification function. Through gameplay, quests, and other channels, players can obtain equipment stones that can be used in the workshop to modified equipment.

At present, there are 8 types of equipment stones in the game, which are: “Change Stone”, “Restore Stone”, “Level Stone”, “Value Stone”, “Affix Stone”, “Stripping Stone”, “Locking Stone”, “Unlocking Stone”.

The effect of each equipment stone, you can refer to the following pic:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/82018f11ca5881f68416cfb443de15f782e33b26.png[/img]

About the value range of affixes, for example: If a weapon has a Crit value of "LV 1:1-10", the Crit rating will be randomly determined from 1 to 10. Then, raising the Crit rating of the weapon to “LV 2: 5-15” by using a Level Stone, the Crit value of the equipment will be randomly determined from 5-15.

[h1]Transfer & Synthesis[/h1]

After the equipment is enchanted and modified, what if you get a more powerful equipment, but you don't want to waste the resources that already used on the old equipment, or the old equipment has better affixes? Equipment transfer can solve your problem!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/efbdb67ed102d10397b009a6c84ef15ec40b61c9.png[/img]

If you select the old equipment as the material, you can choose whether to transfer the enchanting state of the material and the equipment attributes to the target equipment through the equipment transfer function, so you don't have to worry about the waste of materials!

About the synthesis system, it allows you to select excess equipment as materials and then enhance more powerful equipment. After consuming material equipment, you can increase the equipment's attributes and the upper limit of enhancement. It is important to note that the material and the target need to be the same equipment.

This is the basic introduction of the workshop strategy, if you have questions about the workshop content, welcome to leave a comment! See you next time!

notes.title: [Dev Log②]Summary of the first testing in 2021 (1)
notes.content:
Hi, I’m Wang. Keep sharing the technical testing log causally. The technical test in June lasted seven days, and although there were a lot of serious problems, the feedback was much better than I expected.

To be frankly to say, the preparation of this testing is too rush to show full contents and well quality. Due to the development period is too long, the team in inevitably experienced some burnout, which caused these results. So the team especially need external feedback and pressure, whether positive or negative, which is better than none at all. Thanks to the rational and positive comments from our players this time, it gave us a lot of motivation.

For this testing, I summarized the following questions:

[h3][b]1: The Value of Economic System[/b][/h3]
There is a big problem with the economy value system this time. The reason is that we adjusted the difficulty of the “Trial Maze” before package the client, but forgot to adjust the production efficiency of the “Hero Orb” at the same time. This result in the players having to challenge difficult levels while can only acquiring items that don't match the difficulty level. The “Hero Orb” are one of the most important items for leveling up, so the lack of orbs makes it difficult to level up the next day. It was a huge mistake, which is also a lesson for us. There will be a lot of mistakes when we not prepare enough. For the next testing, I hope we can prepare for it with ease.

[h3][b]2: The Game Contents of the First day & The Duration of Gaming[/b][/h3]
According to the backstage statistics, the average of play time of the first day was over three hours, which was way ahead of our expectations. We analyzed it and realized that we didn't plan the game contents of the first day carefully enough, which led to several major problems: players were too tired, there was a lot of contents they didn't understand, and the next day's gameplay dropped dramatically. This is reflected in the back office numbers as well, and our third day retention rate has declined very sharply. 
This is reflected in the backstage's statistics as well, it showed our retention rate has declined very sharply on the third day. We plan to adjust the arrangement of the first day’s contents, more ingenious but not messy, we’ll advance the fun of Gear Build for players early on and delay some new contents of gameplay to a later day. At the same time, we plan to add some more interesting contents before the next testing, and as the story content grows into mass production in the future, we believe the experience of the game will increase dramatically.

[h3][b]3: The Battle System[/b][/h3]
The most serious problem with the battle system is some pathfinding bugs that cause players to get stuck, we are working on fixing them.
The adjustment of battle balance is an ongoing process, and we are constantly working on calculations and optimizations to enhance less-popular S-class heroes and optimize their mechanics. After that, we will continue to add new equipment and new heroes. Before the launch, we expect to add about 200 new equipment and 8 new heroes. We hope players can discover the fun between heroes and heroes and between heroes and equipment by themselves.

[h3][b]A good companion for a beginner——Scarlett, Under optimization and adjustment[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/c9775e058ab77d1138d59af892229385d41126ea.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]4: Bugs & Performance[/b][/h3]
Bugs piled up... And when we saw players feedback seriously, with gratitude and shame, we wrote it all down and will work it out.
Some players have also reported that the computer is heating up when play, and we are working hard to solve it. This problem will improve as time goes on.

That's it for today, and next time I'll talk about the direction of the game and some bits and pieces of understanding.
Hoping that players who are interested in can add us to wishlist to support us, and we will continue to work hard. ;D

notes.title: Daily Chat#9
notes.content:
[h1]Today I will tell you another gameplay in the wild scene-the land of eternal winter.[/h1]
The land of eternal winter, as the name suggests, is covered by winter for some reason, losing three seasons. There are many extremely powerful evil creatures in this area, and you can get rich prizes if you knock them down.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/8ffa786463431565e35f446ff1f75287900aa8ea.png[/img]
There are ten levels in the Land of eternal winter, and everyone has three challenge opportunities every day. No matter the battle is successful or unsuccessful, the challenge opportunity will not be deducted. Only when the player completes the ten-level challenge or chooses to manually refresh the level, the challenge opportunity will be deducted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/885066cc47bea092a729767597ebfeafa47a9b18.png[/img]
The biggest difference between the Land of eternal winter and Trial Maze is that Everwinter Land is a 3v3 battle. Regardless of victory or defeat in the battle, heroes that have already been in battle cannot go back to battle until the current challenge is refreshed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/741007daabcebadccae7e0a6d0538826567023b9.png[/img]
The Land of Eternal Winter is one of the main output channels of Hero Orbs. To pass the Land of Eternal Winter, players need to carefully plan the challenge lineup of each layer.
In the future, we will also open exclusive stores in the Land of  eternal winter for players to exchange for high-quality items.

notes.title: Daily Chat#7
notes.content:
[h1]I believe that many players will feel bored gradually after experiencing the main line level for a long time. Therefore, we created a maze gameplay for players and provided a long-term pve tower climbing game.[/h1]
Click the [Field] button at the bottom of the interface to enter the field interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/2f24bc0f42d7faf45036a3c584ba4a2f92d87d0e.png[/img]
On the right side of the interface is our trial maze.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/7e75c0e14fb8701612e98b6bd0f815eaf878e4e3.png[/img]
When the player enters the trial maze for the first time, they will have 7 opportunities to challenge the trial maze. After that, one chance will be restored every day, but the upper limit is seven chances.
Before starting the battle, players need to set up their own formation to climb the tower. The lineup and combat effectiveness of both parties will be displayed. When you are ready, click [Start] in the center of the interface to start the battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/f14b54f52646cbae6586e30ad7cb90dbca78f6fd.png[/img]

Each layer maze has a fixed 15-second [trial time].[Return Time] will be consumed when the player’s battle time exceeds 15 seconds. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/de655dab3d68f5b45725b978c4ab2967e5c00f96.png[/img]
Players have 5 minutes of [Return Time] each time they challenge the maze, and the remaining [Return Time] of each battle will be displayed in the upper left corner of the battle interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/8f5ae20fc5c96deeebab7a99eaae689ae84720c8.png[/img]

When all the player characters die, or the return time is exhausted. After judging that the trial is over, displaying the reward for this trial and exiting the interface, the player needs to start the trial from the first level of the maze. If the player successfully clears the level and chooses to leave temporarily in the settlement interface, there is no need to start the trial from the first level of the maze.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/96404018470f884141f2d1eadbcb7a8fb836848d.png[/img]

Challenge the maze of trials to get very rich rewards and the unique [maze coin]. [Maze Coin] can be exchanged for 5-star A-level heroes, and even for the only ss-level hero in the currently game , Frozen Heart.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/8b06001188608eadf897afbbfdcb13ad9d156b27.png[/img]

notes.title: Daily Chat #5
notes.content:
[h1]On-hook treasure chest[/h1]
During the game, the on-hook treasure box at the bottom of the game interface will provide us with the resources needed for upgrading and the materials for growth. These resources are necessary for us to become stronger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/cbb6a34e5f8fd7e77c4f8f5eb83ce37403bf8897.png[/img]
The materials that can be produced in the on-hook treasure chest include soul experience, magic stone, potential experience, hero orb, and alchemy powder.
Soul experience can upgrade the player’s own level. Magic Stone is a necessary material for magic research, potential experience is used to upgrade heroes’ rank, hero orb can promote heroes,alchemy powder is used to strengthen various parts of the hero.
Players can receive the rewards of the hang-up treasure chest at any time. The hang-up time includes offline time. The longer the hang-up time, the richer the rewards. However, the upper limit of each reward collection is eight hours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/74a1a34cb2ca02ecd65190f507a24fa68a68a36e.png[/img]
In addition, by clicking on the hourglass icon at the top left of the treasure chest, players have two opportunities a day to directly receive the eight-hour hang-up bonus. The first time is free, and the second time it costs 50 diamonds. The reset time is currently set at 8 o'clock in China time, and may be adjusted later.

notes.title: Daily Chat #4
notes.content:
[h1]Equipment can greatly improve the combat effectiveness of heroes. This time we will talk about the way to obtain equipment in the game.[/h1]
In the last issue of Daily Chat, we mentioned that every ten summons can get crystals to unlock epic equipment treasure chests.It takes 2400 crystals to open an epic equipment treasure chest and get ten equipment of random quality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/fb32a291df9c36cdc77fc0d1e3d87cd4224557ff.png[/img]
In addition to epic equipment treasure chests, we also set up ordinary treasure chests. Open the ordinary treasure chest once to get three random quality equipment.To open ordinary treasure chests, ordinary treasure chest coupons are consumed. Players can obtain ordinary treasure chest coupons by completing the peerage task.At the same time, we have also set up free ordinary treasure chests. Players can claim ordinary treasure chests for free every 12 hours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/9ba7a9e9b510a82595f75e5bd2377e4ded4f0dd3.png[/img]
The highest quality equipment that treasure chests can obtain is elite (purple) quality. Players can synthesize equipment in the workshop to obtain higher quality equipment.

notes.title: Daily chat #3
notes.content:
[h1]Today I will talk about one of the most important systems in the game-the summoning system[/h1]

In an adventurous journey, in order to defeat stronger and stronger opponents, players need to summon many heroes to help themselves.
Through the guidance of crystal, we can randomly summon heroes of various qualities to help us. Summoning heroes requires the consumption of diamonds, the most precious currency on the mainland. Diamonds can be obtained through various daily tasks, achievement tasks and other channels, of course, players can also choose to recharge to obtain. It costs 300 diamonds to summon once, and only 2700 diamonds to summon ten times at a time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/3ce7089c1a0bafc155617cabffe75bee5231012f.png[/img]
When the player first obtains a hero of purple quality, the card will automatically flip, and the hero’s occupation and name will be displayed on the upper left of the interface. Of course, you can also manually click on the hero card to get the hero information.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/8b1a8cd207913458a40aa775bdf5c8282923dec9.png[/img]
And every ten summons, the treasure box above the crystal will be opened, giving the crystal to each player. Players can use the crystal to exchange equipment treasure chests in the mall.

Heroes of different qualities have different summoning probabilities. The higher the quality, the lower the probability of summoning. If you are lucky, the ten summons may appear the following, or better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/7dbedb58549d950eba57f747afbc1b8cb7c8e519.png[/img]
Of course, if you have bad luck, the following situation may also occur:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/0c087a63ce55470359a2bc0421045bb791630afc.png[/img]
I wish all players can get the hero they want and have a pleasant journey in the game.

notes.title: Daily chat #2
notes.content:
[h1]Today, I will introduce the content related to heroes.[/h1]

Hello players!
In the world of the Book of Yog, there are currently six occupations, namely tank, swordsman, archer, mage, support, and assassin.
The lineup during battle is related to the formation position. Generally, the first three positions are the front row, and the last three positions are the back row. So the first three positions are generally tanks or swordsmen, and the last three positions are remote output, shooter, mage, or our assistant. Of course, if you want to have other lineups, you can also freely arrange positions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/dcea5c02f67d25b3dd1ae424b194300c6dcbeae4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/8a4f073e36b8eb410dfd294102925ddf2df8ba1d.png[/img]
In addition, some heroes also have "bond", and when two heroes with bond play at the same time, they will also add a buff to themselves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/17f55b2f6f297bad70bdf68cc6cf9f71aeb72730.png[/img]
Each hero has a potential level and a gold level. The gold level will only exist in the main level, and the gold level will be reset and cleared every chapter, but the potential level will not.
Don’t worry if you feel that the blue-quality heroes have insufficient combat power. In the grand holy church of the main city, we can upgrade the awakening of the hero, unlock the upper limit of the potential level, and thus improve the combat effectiveness of the hero. Heroes of different qualities have different card numbers for awakening.When the hero quality is low, you can use the hero cards of the same occupation to awaken, while high-quality heroes can only use their own cards to awaken.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/84b23b6c5285d9111c00c4f45694b590c10da424.png[/img]

notes.title: Diary #1
notes.content:
Due to the busy development of the game, many players do not understand our current status. Starting today, we will update some content about the game from time to time so that users who can't play yet to understand it.
[h2]Today, let’s talk about the most basic fighting content of our Book of Yog.[/h2]
1.Our main line is promoted in the form of linear chapters, each chapter has different conditions for customs clearance rewards, and players have the power to go back and challenge any chapters, so don’t worry about missing more rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/14ad4624a7a175d0f6b402fdd389421ad6855d92.jpg[/img]

2.In the battle process, players will enter the Boss level every time they successfully challenge five small levels. The challenges in the Boss level are more difficult than ordinary levels, but I also believe that players can successfully pass the level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/98a3132274732413c61cba35269ae569fc6fdf54.jpg[/img]

3.The hero characters of the players, as the fight time accumulates anger value, and when the anger value is full, the hero character can release their ultimate skill. Players can choose to release it on manually or click the auto button to automatically release the skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/1e03dde5ed75a685ea3dc97797e34b95849fd1d4.png[/img]

4. In the combat process, players can also release skills with mouse clicks to cause damage to monsters. Skills can be unlocked and upgraded through the technology system. The higher the level, the higher the damage.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36093907/f732c2fbfe3d561dd0dc17ada5d17828f754e015.png[/img]

There may be many attentive players who have discovered that each hero card has a special logo in the upper left corner. In the next issue, I will talk to you about heroes and formations.
